शाद्यमस्थिवसाशुक्रप्राणकूपेषु पञ्चकम्
मूर्त्यङ्गानि ततो दत्त्वा शिवमावाहयेद्बुधः
6.m: the pentad beginning with śa on bone, fat, semen, vital breath, and anger. / Then, having applied the limbs of the form, the wise practitioner should invoke Śiva:

6.s:
prāṇopari nyasennābhiṃ tadūrdhve dakṣiṇāṅgulim
vāmakarṇaprameyataḥ sarvasiddhipradaḥ śivaḥ
6.d:
प्राणोपरि न्यसेन्नाभिं तदूर्ध्वे दक्षिणाङ्गुलिम्
वामकर्णप्रमेयतः सर्वसिद्धिप्रदः शिवः
6.m: Above the vital breath one should place the navel; above that, the right finger; / woven with the left ear, Śiva bestows all attainments.

6.s:
sadbhāvaḥ paramo hyeṣa bhairavasya mahātmanaḥ
aṅgānyanena kāryāṇi pūrvavatsvarabhedataḥ
6.d:
सद्भावः परमो ह्येष भैरवस्य महात्मनः
अङ्गान्यनेन कार्याणि पूर्ववत्स्वरभेदतः
6.m: This is indeed the supreme essence of the great-souled Bhairava. / The limbs must be made with this, according to the distinction of vowels as before.

6.s:
mūrtiḥ sṛṣṭiścitattvaṃ ca aṣṭau mūrtyaṅgasaṃyutāḥ
śivaḥ sāṅgaśca ṣoḍhaiva nyāsaḥ saṃparikīrtitaḥ
6.d:
मूर्तिः सृष्टिश्चितत्त्वं च अष्टौ मूर्त्यङ्गसंयुताः
शिवः साङ्गश्च षोढैव न्यासः संपरिकीर्तितः
6.m: The form, the emanation, and the triad of tattvas, [and] the eight accompanied by the limbs of the form, / and Śiva with his limbs: the nyāsa is proclaimed to be sixfold indeed.

6.s:
asyopari tataḥ śāktaṃ kuryānnyāsaṃ yathā śṛṇu
mūrtau parāparāṃ nyasya tadvakrāṇi ca mālinīm
6.d:
अस्योपरि ततः शाक्तं कुर्यान्न्यासं यथा शृणु
मूर्तौ परापरां न्यस्य तद्वक्राणि च मालिनीम्
6.m: Then, hear how one should perform the Śākta nyāsa upon this: / having imposed Parāparā on the form, and Mālinī on its faces,

6.s:
parāditritayaṃ paścācchikhāhṛtpādagaṃ nyaset
kavakrakaṇṭhahṛnnābhiguhyorūpādagaṃ kramāt
6.d:
परादित्रितयं पश्चाच्छिखाहृत्पादगं न्यसेत्
कवक्रकण्ठहृन्नाभिगुह्योरूपादगं क्रमात्
6.m: thereafter one should place the triad beginning with Parā on the crest, heart, and feet; / on the ka-face, throat, heart, navel, genitals, thighs, and feet in sequence,

6.s:
aghoryādyaṣṭakaṃ nyasya vidyāṅgāni tu pūrvavat
tatastvāvāhayecchaktiṃ sarvayoginamaskṛtām
6.d:
अघोर्याद्यष्टकं न्यस्य विद्याङ्गानि तु पूर्ववत्
ततस्त्वावाहयेच्छक्तिं सर्वयोगिनमस्कृताम्
6.m: having imposed the octad beginning with Aghorī, and the limbs of Vidyā as before, / one should then invoke Śakti, who is revered by all yogins.

6.s:
jīvaḥ prāṇapuṭāntasthaḥ kālānalasamadyutiḥ
atidīptastu vāmāṅghribhūṣito mūrdhni bindunā
6.d:
जीवः प्राणपुटान्तस्थः कालानलसमद्युतिः
अतिदीप्तस्तु वामाङ्घ्रिभूषितो मूर्ध्नि बिन्दुना
6.m: The jīva, residing within the enclosure of the vital breath, has the radiance of the fire of destruction, / extremely blazing, adorned with the left foot, and with a bindu on the crown,

6.s:
dakṣajānuyutaścāyaṃ sarvamātṛgaṇānvita̍ḥ
anena prīṇitāḥ sarvā dadate vāñchitaṃ phalam
6.d:
दक्षजानुयुतश्चायं सर्वमातृगणान्वित̍ः
अनेन प्रीणिताः सर्वा ददते वाञ्छितं फलम्
6.m: and joined with the right knee, accompanied by the entire host of mothers. / Gratified by this, they all bestow the desired fruit.

6.s:
sadbhāvaḥ paramo hyeṣa mātṛṇāṃ paripaṭhyate
tasmādenāṃ japenmantrī ya icchetsiddhimṛttamām
6.d:
सद्भावः परमो ह्येष मातृणां परिपठ्यते
तस्मादेनां जपेन्मन्त्री य इच्छेत्सिद्धिमृत्तमाम्
6.m: This is declared to be the supreme essence of the mothers; / therefore, the mantrī who desires the highest attainment should recite it.

6.s:
rudraśaktisamāveśo nityamatra pratiṣṭhitaḥ
yasmādeṣā parāśaktirbhedanānena̍ kīrtitā
6.d:
रुद्रशक्तिसमावेशो नित्यमत्र प्रतिष्ठितः
यस्मादेषा पराशक्तिर्भेदनानेन̍ कीर्तिता
6.m: The absorption of Rudra's power is permanently established here, / because this Parāśakti has been proclaimed by this division.

6.s:
yāvatyaḥ siddhayastantre sarvā̍ḥ syuranayā kṛtāḥ
aṅgāni kalpayedasyāḥ pūrvavatsvarabhedataḥ
6.d:
यावत्यः सिद्धयस्तन्त्रे सर्वा̍ः स्युरनया कृताः
अङ्गानि कल्पयेदस्याः पूर्ववत्स्वरभेदतः
6.m: Whatever attainments exist in the tantra are all accomplished by her. / One should construct her limbs according to the distinction of vowels as before.

6.s:
mūrtiḥ savaktrā śaktiśca vidyātritaya eva ca
aghoryādyaṣṭakaṃ ceti tathā vidyāṅgapañcakam
6.d:
मूर्तिः सवक्त्रा शक्तिश्च विद्यात्रितय एव च
अघोर्याद्यष्टकं चेति तथा विद्याङ्गपञ्चकम्
6.m: The form with the faces, Śakti, and the triad of vidyās, / the octad beginning with Aghorī, and the pentad of vidyā-limbs,

6.s:
sāṅgā caiva parā śaktirnyāsaḥ prokto'tha ṣaḍvidhaḥ
yāmalo'yamto nyāsaḥ sarvasiddhiprasiddhaye
6.d:
साङ्गा चैव परा शक्तिर्न्यासः प्रोक्तोऽथ षड्विधः
यामलोऽयम्तो न्यासः सर्वसिद्धिप्रसिद्धये
6.m: and Parāśakti with her limbs: the nyāsa is said to be sixfold. / Therefore, this twin nyāsa is for the accomplishment of all attainments.

6.s:
vāmo vāyaṃ vidhiḥ kāryoṃ muktimārgāvalambibhiḥ
varṇamantravibhedena pṛthagvā tatphalārthibhiḥ
6.d:
वामो वायं विधिः कार्यों मुक्तिमार्गावलम्बिभिः
वर्णमन्त्रविभेदेन पृथग्वा तत्फलार्थिभिः
6.m: Or this left-hand procedure should be performed by those who follow the path of liberation, / or separately according to the distinction of phonemes and mantras by those who seek their fruit.

6.s:
yāvantaḥ kīrtitā bhedaiḥ śaṃbhuśaktyaṇuvācakāḥ
tāvatsvapyevamevāyaṃ nyāsaḥ pañcavidho mataḥ
6.d:
यावन्तः कीर्तिता भेदैः शंभुशक्त्यणुवाचकाः
तावत्स्वप्येवमेवायं न्यासः पञ्चविधो मतः
6.m: As many divisions as are proclaimed that denote Śaṃbhu, Śakti, and the individual soul, / for so many also this nyāsa is held to be fivefold in just this way.

6.s:
kiṃtu bāhyastu yo yatra sa tatrāṅgasamanvitaḥ
ṣaṣṭhaḥ syāditi sarvatra ṣoḍhaivāyamudāhṛtaḥ
6.d:
किंतु बाह्यस्तु यो यत्र स तत्राङ्गसमन्वितः
षष्ठः स्यादिति सर्वत्र षोढैवायमुदाहृतः
6.m: However, that which is external anywhere is there endowed with its limbs, / and would be the sixth; thus it is taught to be sixfold everywhere.

6.s:
svānuṣṭhānāvirodhena bhāvābhāvavikalpanaiḥ
yāgadravyāṇi sarvāṇi kāryāṇi vidhivadbudhaiḥ
6.d:
स्वानुष्ठानाविरोधेन भावाभावविकल्पनैः
यागद्रव्याणि सर्वाणि कार्याणि विधिवद्बुधैः
6.m: Without contradiction to one's own practice, by conceiving presence and absence, / all the sacrificial substances should be prepared according to rule by the wise.

6.s:
tato'rghapātramādāya bhāvābhāvāvikalpitam
tataścāstrāgnisaṃdagdhaṃ śaktyambuplāvitaṃ śuci
6.d:
ततोऽर्घपात्रमादाय भावाभावाविकल्पितम्
ततश्चास्त्राग्निसंदग्धं शक्त्यम्बुप्लावितं शुचि
6.m: Then, taking the argha-vessel conceived through presence and absence, / and then burned by the fire of the Astra, flooded with the water of the Śakti, pure—

6.s:
kartavyā yasya saṃśuddhiṃranyasyāpyatra vastunaḥ
tasyānenaiva mārgeṇa prakartavyā vijānatā
6.d:
कर्तव्या यस्य संशुद्धिंरन्यस्याप्यत्र वस्तुनः
तस्यानेनैव मार्गेण प्रकर्तव्या विजानता
6.m: whatever other substance here whose purification is to be performed, / its [purification] must be performed in just this manner by the discerning practitioner.

6.s:
na cāsaṃśodhitaṃ vastu kiṃcidapyatraṃ kalpayet
tenaṃ śuddhaṃ tu sarvaṃ yadaśuddhamapi tacchuci
6.d:
न चासंशोधितं वस्तु किंचिदप्यत्रं कल्पयेत्
तेनं शुद्धं तु सर्वं यदशुद्धमपि तच्छुचि
6.m: And one should not utilize any unpurified substance here at all; / whatever is purified by that, even if impure, is pure.

6.s:
tadambunā samāpūrya ṣaḍriraṅgaiḥ samarpya ca
amṛtīkṛtya sarvāṇi tena dravyāṇi śodhayet
6.d:
तदम्बुना समापूर्य षड्रिरङ्गैः समर्प्य च
अमृतीकृत्य सर्वाणि तेन द्रव्याणि शोधयेत्
6.m: Having filled it with that water, and offering it with the six limbs, / having turned all into nectar, one should purify the substances with it.

6.s:
ātmānaṃ pūjayitvā tu kuryādantaḥkṛtiṃ yathā
tathā te kathayiṣyāmi sarvayogigaṇārcite
6.d:
आत्मानं पूजयित्वा तु कुर्यादन्तःकृतिं यथा
तथा ते कथयिष्यामि सर्वयोगिगणार्चिते
6.m: Having worshipped oneself, how one should perform the internal ritual, / that I shall tell you, O lady worshipped by the assembly of all yogins.

6.s:
ādāvādhāraśaktiṃ tu nābhyadhaścaturaṅgulām
dharāṃ surodaṃ potaṃ ca kandaśceti catuṣṭayam
6.d:
आदावाधारशक्तिं तु नाभ्यधश्चतुरङ्गुलाम्
धरां सुरोदं पोतं च कन्दश्चेति चतुष्टयम्
6.m: First, [one should visualize] the foundation power four finger-breadths below the navel; / the earth, the ocean of wine, the ship, and the bulb: these four,

6.s:
ekaikāṅgulametatsyācchūlasyāmalasārakam
tato nālamanantākhyaṃ daṇḍamasya prakalpayet
6.d:
एकैकाङ्गुलमेतत्स्याच्छूलस्यामलसारकम्
ततो नालमनन्ताख्यं दण्डमस्य प्रकल्पयेत्
6.m: each one finger-breadth, are the pure essence of the trident. / Then one should construct its staff, the stalk named Ananta.

6.s:
lambikāvadhitaścātra śūlordhvaṃ granthiriṣyate
abhittvainaṃ mahādevi pāśajālamahārṇavam
6.d:
लम्बिकावधितश्चात्र शूलोर्ध्वं ग्रन्थिरिष्यते
अभित्त्वैनं महादेवि पाशजालमहार्णवम्
6.m: And extending up to the uvula, the knot is held to be above the trident here; / without piercing this, O great goddess, this great ocean of the net of bonds,

6.s:
na sa yogamavāpnoti śivena saha mānavaḥ
dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca catuṣṭayam
6.d:
न स योगमवाप्नोति शिवेन सह मानवः
धर्मं ज्ञानं च वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं च चतुष्टयम्
6.m: that human being does not attain union with Śiva. / Dharma, knowledge, dispassion, and sovereignty: these four,

6.s:
koṇeṣu cintayenmantrī āgneyādiṣvanukramāt
gātrakāṇāṃ catuṣkaṃ ca dikṣu pūrvādiṣu smaret
6.d:
कोणेषु चिन्तयेन्मन्त्री आग्नेयादिष्वनुक्रमात्
गात्रकाणां चतुष्कं च दिक्षु पूर्वादिषु स्मरेत्
6.m: the mantrī should visualize in the corners, in sequence beginning with the south-east; / and one should remember the tetrad of legs in the directions, beginning with the east.

6.s:
grantherūrdhvaṃ triśūlādho bhavitavyā catuṣkikā
vidyātattvaṃ tadevāhuśchedanatrayasaṃyutam
6.d:
ग्रन्थेरूर्ध्वं त्रिशूलाधो भवितव्या चतुष्किका
विद्यातत्त्वं तदेवाहुश्छेदनत्रयसंयुतम्
6.m: Above the knot and beneath the trident, there must be a square seat; / they declare that to be the vidyātattva, endowed with three coverings.

6.s:
kaṃkhalambikayormadhye tattattvamanucintayet
padmākṛtiṃ kakhatattvamaiśvaraṃ cintayedbudhaḥ
6.d:
कंखलम्बिकयोर्मध्ये तत्तत्त्वमनुचिन्तयेत्
पद्माकृतिं कखतत्त्वमैश्वरं चिन्तयेद्बुधः
6.m: Between the uvula and the roof of the palate, one should contemplate that tattva. / The wise one should contemplate the lotus-shaped tattva of the roof of the palate belonging to Īśvara,

6.s:
karṇikākesaropetaṃ sabījaṃ vikasatsitam
pūrvapatrāditaḥ paścādvāmādinavakaṃ nyaset
6.d:
कर्णिकाकेसरोपेतं सबीजं विकसत्सितम्
पूर्वपत्रादितः पश्चाद्वामादिनवकं न्यसेत्
6.m: provided with pericarp and filaments, with its seed, blooming white. / Starting from the eastern petal, one should then place the ennead beginning with Vāmā:

6.s:
vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca kālī ceti tathā parā
kalavikaraṇī caiva balavikaraṇī tathā
6.d:
वामा ज्येष्ठा च रौद्री च काली चेति तथा परा
कलविकरणी चैव बलविकरणी तथा
6.m: Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, Raudrī, Kālī, and likewise Parā, / Kalavikaraṇī, and also Balavikaraṇī,

6.s:
balapramathanī cānyā sarvabhūtadamanthapi
manonmanī ca madhye'pi bhānumārgeṇa vinyaset
6.d:
बलप्रमथनी चान्या सर्वभूतदमन्थपि
मनोन्मनी च मध्येऽपि भानुमार्गेण विन्यसेत्
6.m: and Balapramathanī, Sarvabhūtadamanī, / and Manonmanī in the center: one should place them following the path of the sun.

6.s:
vibhvādinavakaṃ cānyadvilomātparikalpayet
vibhurjñānī kriyā cecchā vāgīśī jvālinī tathā 65
vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca sarvāḥ kālānalaprabhāḥ
brahmaviṣṇuharāḥ pūrvaṃ ye śāktāḥ pratipāditāḥ
6.d:
विभ्वादिनवकं चान्यद्विलोमात्परिकल्पयेत्
विभुर्ज्ञानी क्रिया चेच्छा वागीशी ज्वालिनी तथा 65
वामा ज्येष्ठा च रौद्री च सर्वाः कालानलप्रभाः
ब्रह्मविष्णुहराः पूर्वं ये शाक्ताः प्रतिपादिताः
6.m:
And one should project the other ennead beginning with Vibhu in reverse order: / Vibhu, Jñānin, Kriyā, and Icchā, Vāgīśī, Jvālinī,

Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, and Raudrī—all having the splendor of the fire of destruction. / Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Hara, who were previously explained as śākta,

6.s:
dalakesaramadhyasthā maṇḍalānāṃ ta īśvarāḥ
dhvani ? cārkenduvahnīnāṃ saṃjñayā paribhāvayet
6.d:
दलकेसरमध्यस्था मण्डलानां त ईश्वराः
ध्वनि ? चार्केन्दुवह्नीनां संज्ञया परिभावयेत्
6.m: stationed on the petals, filaments, and center, are the lords of the maṇḍalas. / One should contemplate the recognizable sound […] of the sun, moon, and fire.

6.s:
īśvaraṃ ca mahāpretaṃ prahasantaṃ sacetanam
kālāgnikoṭivapuṣamityevaṃ sarvamāsanam
6.d:
ईश्वरं च महाप्रेतं प्रहसन्तं सचेतनम्
कालाग्निकोटिवपुषमित्येवं सर्वमासनम्
6.m: And Īśvara as the great corpse, laughing, conscious, / having a body like ten million fires of time: thus is the entire seat.

6.s:
tasya nābhyutthitaṃ śaktiśūlaśṛṅgatvayaṃ smaret
kakhatrayeṇa niryātaṃ dvādaśāntāvasānakam
6.d:
तस्य नाभ्युत्थितं शक्तिशूलशृङ्गत्वयं स्मरेत्
कखत्रयेण निर्यातं द्वादशान्तावसानकम्
6.m: One should visualize the triad of points of the power-trident rising from his navel, / issuing through the three cavities of the palate, terminating at the dvādaśānta.

6.s:
cintayettasya śṛṅgeṣu śāktaṃ padmatrayaṃ tataḥ
sarvādhiṣṭhāyakaṃ śukramityetatparamāsanam
6.d:
चिन्तयेत्तस्य शृङ्गेषु शाक्तं पद्मत्रयं ततः
सर्वाधिष्ठायकं शुक्रमित्येतत्परमासनम्
6.m: He should then visualize upon its prongs a triad of lotus flowers related to Śakti / which governs everything, white, [represented by] 'ām': this is the supreme seat.

6.s:
tatropari tato mūrtiṃ vidyākhyāmanucintayet
ātmākhyāṃ ca tatastasyāṃ pūrvanyāsaṃ śivātmakam 71
tato madhye parāṃ śaktiṃ dakṣiṇottarayordvayam
parāparāṃ svarūpeṇa raktavarṇāṃ mahābalām
6.d:
तत्रोपरि ततो मूर्तिं विद्याख्यामनुचिन्तयेत्
आत्माख्यां च ततस्तस्यां पूर्वन्यासं शिवात्मकम् 71
ततो मध्ये परां शक्तिं दक्षिणोत्तरयोर्द्वयम्
परापरां स्वरूपेण रक्तवर्णां महाबलाम्
6.m:
Above that, he should subsequently visualize the form named Vidyā, / and then the one named Ātman; upon it, the prior imposition consisting of Śiva.

Then, in the center, Parā Śakti; to the right and left, the pair: / Parāparā in her essential form, red in color, of great power,

6.s:
icchārūpadharāṃ dhyātvā kiṃcidugrāṃ na bhīṣaṇām
aparāṃ vāmaśṛṅge tu bhīṣaṇāṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgalām
6.d:
इच्छारूपधरां ध्यात्वा किंचिदुग्रां न भीषणाम्
अपरां वामशृङ्गे तु भीषणां कृष्णपिङ्गलाम्
6.m: visualizing her as assuming any form at will, somewhat fierce but not terrifying; / and on the left prong Aparā, terrifying, dark and tawny,

6.s:
icchārūpadharāṃ devīṃ praṇatārtivināśinīm
parāṃ cāpyāyanīṃ devīṃ candrakoṭacyutaprabhām
6.d:
इच्छारूपधरां देवीं प्रणतार्तिविनाशिनीम्
परां चाप्यायनीं देवीं चन्द्रकोटच्युतप्रभाम्
6.m: the goddess assuming any form at will, destroying the affliction of those who bow down; / and the goddess Parā, who nourishes, with the brilliance of ten million moons.

6.s:
ṣaḍvidhe'pi kṛte śākte mūrtyādāvapi cintayet
vidyāṅgapañcakaṃ paścādāgneyyādiṣu vinyaset
6.d:
षड्विधेऽपि कृते शाक्ते मूर्त्यादावपि चिन्तयेत्
विद्याङ्गपञ्चकं पश्चादाग्नेय्यादिषु विन्यसेत्
6.m: When the sixfold [imposition] related to Śakti is performed, he should also visualize [them] in the form and the rest; / afterwards, he should deposit the pentad of limbs of the Vidyā in the direction of the fire and the others.

6.s:
agnīśarakṣovāyūnāṃ dakṣiṇe ca yathākramam
śaktyaṅgāni śivāṅgāni tathaiva vidhinā smaret
6.d:
अग्नीशरक्षोवायूनां दक्षिणे च यथाक्रमम्
शक्त्यङ्गानि शिवाङ्गानि तथैव विधिना स्मरेत्
6.m: And to the right of the fire, īśa, rakṣas, and wind, in due order, / he should similarly contemplate according to rule the limbs of Śakti and the limbs of Śiva.

6.s:
kiṃtu śakrādidikṣvastramantraṃ madhye ca locanam
aghorādyaṣṭakaṃ dhyāyedaghoryādyaṣṭakānvitam
6.d:
किंतु शक्रादिदिक्ष्वस्त्रमन्त्रं मध्ये च लोचनम्
अघोराद्यष्टकं ध्यायेदघोर्याद्यष्टकान्वितम्
6.m: However, in the directions beginning with Indra [he should place] the weapon-mantra, and in the center the eye. / He should visualize the octad beginning with Aghora accompanied by the octad beginning with Aghorī,

6.s:
sarvāsāmānṛtatvena lokapālāṃśca bāhyataḥ
sāstrāṃnsvamantraiḥ saṃcintya japaṃ paścātsamārabhet
6.d:
सर्वासामानृतत्वेन लोकपालांश्च बाह्यतः
सास्त्रांन्स्वमन्त्रैः संचिन्त्य जपं पश्चात्समारभेत्
6.m: as surrounding all of them; and outside, the world-protectors, / bearing weapons, meditating on them with their own mantras; afterwards he should commence the recitation.

6.s:
svarūpe talla̱yo bhūtvā ekaikāṃ daśadhā smaret
jvalatpāvakasaṃkāśāṃ dhyātvā svāhāntamuccaret
6.d:
स्वरूपे तल्ल̱यो भूत्वा एकैकां दशधा स्मरेत्
ज्वलत्पावकसंकाशां ध्यात्वा स्वाहान्तमुच्चरेत्
6.m: Dissolving himself into their essential nature, he should contemplate each one ten times; / visualizing [her] as resembling blazing fire, he should utter [the mantra] ending in svāhā,

6.s:
sakṛdekaikaśo mantrī homakarmaprasiddhaye
ityeva mānaso yāgaḥ kathitaḥ sāmudāyikaḥ
6.d:
सकृदेकैकशो मन्त्री होमकर्मप्रसिद्धये
इत्येव मानसो यागः कथितः सामुदायिकः
6.m: once for each individually, the practitioner of mantras, for the accomplishment of the rite of oblations. / Thus indeed the internal sacrifice has been described collectively.

6.s:
etatriśūlamuddiṣṭamekadaṇḍaṃ triśaktikam
itthametadvijñāya śaktiśūlaṃ varānane
6.d:
एतत्रिशूलमुद्दिष्टमेकदण्डं त्रिशक्तिकम्
इत्थमेतद्विज्ञाय शक्तिशूलं वरानने
6.m: This trident has been taught as having a single shaft and three Śaktis. / Without knowing this trident of Śaktis in this manner, O fair-faced one,

6.s:
baddhvāpi khecarīṃ mudrāṃ notpatatyavanītalāt
ityetacchāṃbhavaṃ proktamaṣṭāntaṃ śāktamiṣyate
6.d:
बद्ध्वापि खेचरीं मुद्रां नोत्पतत्यवनीतलात्
इत्येतच्छांभवं प्रोक्तमष्टान्तं शाक्तमिष्यते
6.m: even though one has bound the Khecarī mudrā, one does not rise up from the surface of the earth. / Thus this śāmbhava [trident] is spoken of; the śākta is held to end in the eighth,

6.s:
turyāntamāṇavaṃ vidyāditi śūlatrayaṃ matam
pṛthagyāgavidhānena śakticakraṃ vicintayet
6.d:
तुर्यान्तमाणवं विद्यादिति शूलत्रयं मतम्
पृथग्यागविधानेन शक्तिचक्रं विचिन्तयेत्
6.m: one should know the āṇava as ending in the fourth: such is considered the triad of tridents. / He should visualize the circle of Śaktis according to the procedure of a separate sacrifice;

6.s:
tenāpi khecarīṃ baddhā tyajatyevaṃ mahītalam
tato'bhimantrya dhānyāni mahāstreṇa trisaptadhā
6.d:
तेनापि खेचरीं बद्धा त्यजत्येवं महीतलम्
ततोऽभिमन्त्र्य धान्यानि महास्त्रेण त्रिसप्तधा
6.m: by that too, having bound the Khecarī, he indeed leaves the surface of the earth. / Then, consecrating grains with the great weapon three times seven,

6.s:
nikṣipeddikṣu sarvāsu jvalatpāvakavatsmaret
nirvighnaṃ tadgṛhaṃ dhyātvā saṃhṛteśadiśaṃ nayet
6.d:
निक्षिपेद्दिक्षु सर्वासु ज्वलत्पावकवत्स्मरेत्
निर्विघ्नं तद्गृहं ध्यात्वा संहृतेशदिशं नयेत्
6.m: he should scatter them in all directions; he should visualize them like blazing fire. / Visualizing that chamber as free from obstacles, gathering them up, he should bring them to the direction of Īśa.

6.s:
pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ kuryādvadanaiḥ pañcabhirbudhaḥ
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ caiva kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā
6.d:
पञ्चगव्यं ततः कुर्याद्वदनैः पञ्चभिर्बुधः
गोमूत्रं गोमयं चैव क्षीरं दधि घृतं तथा
6.m: Then the wise one should prepare the five products of the cow with the five faces: / cow urine, cow dung, milk, curd, and clarified butter.

6.s:
mantrayedūrdhvaparyantaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgena kuśòdakam
mudre dravyāmṛtaṃ baddhā tattvaṃ tasya vicintayet
6.d:
मन्त्रयेदूर्ध्वपर्यन्तैः षडङ्गेन कुश्òदकम्
मुद्रे द्रव्यामृतं बद्धा तत्त्वं तस्य विचिन्तयेत्
6.m: He should consecrate [them] with the [mantras] ending with the upper one, and the water with kuśa grass with the six limbs. / Having bound the mudrā of the nectar of substances, he should contemplate its true nature.

6.s:
tena saṃprokṣayedbhūmiṃ svalpenānyannidhāpayet
vāstuyāgaṃ tataḥ kuryānmālinyuccārayogataḥ
6.d:
तेन संप्रोक्षयेद्भूमिं स्वल्पेनान्यन्निधापयेत्
वास्तुयागं ततः कुर्यान्मालिन्युच्चारयोगतः
6.m: With that he should sprinkle the ground; with a small portion he should store the rest. / Then he should perform the sacrifice to the site through the practice of uttering the Mālinī.

6.s:
puṣpairañjalimāpūrya pheṃkārādi samuccaran
dhyātvā śaktyantamadhvānaṃ nakārānte vinikṣipet
6.d:
पुष्पैरञ्जलिमापूर्य फेंकारादि समुच्चरन्
ध्यात्वा शक्त्यन्तमध्वानं नकारान्ते विनिक्षिपेत्
6.m: Filling his cupped hands with flowers, he should pronounce [the letters] beginning with the letter pha; / contemplating the cosmic path up to Śakti, he should deposit [them] at the end of the letter na.

6.s:
gandhadhūpādikaṃ dattvā gaṇeśānaṃ prapūjayet
ṣaḍutthamāsanaṃ nyasya praṇavena tatopari
6.d:
गन्धधूपादिकं दत्त्वा गणेशानं प्रपूजयेत्
षडुत्थमासनं न्यस्य प्रणवेन ततोपरि
6.m: Offering perfume, incense, and the like, he should worship Gaṇeśa. / Having imposed the seat arising from six, with the Praṇava above that,

6.s:
gāmityanena vighneśaṃ gandhadhūpādibhiryajet
asyāṅgāni gakāreṇa ṣaḍdīrghasvarayogataḥ
6.d:
गामित्यनेन विघ्नेशं गन्धधूपादिभिर्यजेत्
अस्याङ्गानि गकारेण षड्दीर्घस्वरयोगतः
6.m: he should worship the Lord of Obstacles with 'gām', with perfume, flowers, and the like; / his limbs with the letter ga in conjunction with the six long vowels.

6.s:
trinetramuditaṃ dhyātvā gajāsyaṃ vāmanākṛtim
visarjya siddhikāmastu mahāstramanupūjayet
6.d:
त्रिनेत्रमुदितं ध्यात्वा गजास्यं वामनाकृतिम्
विसर्ज्य सिद्धिकामस्तु महास्त्रमनुपूजयेत्
6.m: Visualizing the elephant-faced one, three-eyed, joyful, in dwarf form, / having dismissed him, one desiring attainment should then worship the great weapon.

6.s:
dattvānantaṃ tathā dharmaṃ jñānaṃ vairāgyameva ca
aiśvaryaṃ karṇikāṃ ceti ṣaḍutthamidamāsanam
6.d:
दत्त्वानन्तं तथा धर्मं ज्ञानं वैराग्यमेव च
ऐश्वर्यं कर्णिकां चेति षडुत्थमिदमासनम्
6.m: Providing Ananta, and likewise righteousness, knowledge, dispassion, / sovereignty, and the pericarp: this is the seat arising from six.

6.s:
asyopari nyaseddhyātvā khaṅgakheṭakadhāriṇam
vikarālaṃ mahādaṃṣṭraṃ mahograṃ bhukuṭīmukham
6.d:
अस्योपरि न्यसेद्ध्यात्वा खङ्गखेटकधारिणम्
विकरालं महादंष्ट्रं महोग्रं भुकुटीमुखम्
6.m: Visualizing upon it, he should place him who bears a sword and shield, / dreadfully frightful, with great fangs, extremely fierce, with a face having knitted brows,

6.s:
svāṅgaṣaṭsamopetaṃ diṅmātṛparivāritam
svārṇairevāṅgaṣaḍḍhaṃ tu phaṭkārapara Belldīpi
svāṅgaṣaṭsamopetaṃ diṅmātṛparivāritam
svārṇai revāṅgaṣaḍḍhaṃ tu phaṭkārapara Belldīpi
svārṇai revāṅgaṣaḍḍhaṃ tu phaṭkārapara Belldīpi
svāṅgaṣaṭsamopetaṃ diṅmātṛparivāritam
svārṇai revāṅgaṣaḍḍhaṃ tu phaṭkārapara Belldīpitam
svārṇai revāṅgaṣaḍḍhaṃ tu phaṭkāraparadīpitam
6.d:
स्वाङ्गषट्समोपेतं दिङ्मातृपरिवारितम्
स्वार्णैरेवाङ्गषड्ढं तु फट्कारपर बेल्ल्दीपि
स्वाङ्गषट्समोपेतं दिङ्मातृपरिवारितम्
स्वार्णै रेवाङ्गषड्ढं तु फट्कारपर बेल्ल्दीपि
स्वार्णै रेवाङ्गषड्ढं तु फट्कारपर बेल्ल्दीपि
स्वाङ्गषट्समोपेतं दिङ्मातृपरिवारितम्
स्वार्णै रेवाङ्गषड्ढं तु फट्कारपर बेल्ल्दीपितम्
स्वार्णै रेवाङ्गषड्ढं तु फट्कारपरदीपितम्
6.m: accompanied by his own group of six limbs, surrounded by the mothers of the directions; / his six limbs [formed] by his own syllables, illuminated by the sound phaṭ.

6.s:
tadrūpameva saṃcintya tato mātraṣṭakaṃ yajet
indrāṇīṃ pūrvapatre tu savajrāṃ yugapatsmaret
6.d:
तद्रूपमेव संचिन्त्य ततो मात्रष्टकं यजेत्
इन्द्राणीं पूर्वपत्रे तु सवज्रां युगपत्स्मरेत्
6.m: Having meditated upon that very form, he should then worship the octad of mothers. / He should visualize Indrāṇī upon the eastern petal, holding a thunderbolt, simultaneously;

6.s:
āgneyīṃ śaktihastāṃ ca yāmyāṃ daṇḍakarāṃ tataḥ
nairṛtīṃ vārunānīṃ ca vāyavīṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ
6.d:
आग्नेयीं शक्तिहस्तां च याम्यां दण्डकरां ततः
नैरृतीं वारुनानीं च वायवीं च विचक्षणः
6.m: the wise one [should visualize] Āgneyī with a lance in her hand, then Yāmyā with a staff in her hand, / Nairṛtī, Vāruṇānī, and Vāyavī,

6.s:
khaṅgapāśadhvajairyuktāṃ cintayedyugapatpriye
kauverīṃ mudrakarāmīśānīṃ śūlasaṃyutām
6.d:
खङ्गपाशध्वजैर्युक्तां चिन्तयेद्युगपत्प्रिये
कौवेरीं मुद्रकरामीशानीं शूलसंयुताम्
6.m: as equipped with sword, noose, and banner simultaneously, O beloved; / Kauverī with a club in her hand, and Īśānī endowed with a trident.

6.s:
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya svatantre homamācaret
ādau ca kalaśaṃ kuryātsasahasrādhikamantritam
6.d:
गन्धपुष्पादिभिः पूज्य स्वतन्त्रे होममाचरेत्
आदौ च कलशं कुर्यात्ससहस्राधिकमन्त्रितम्
6.m: Having worshiped with perfumes, flowers, and the like, he should perform the oblation according to his own system. / And first he should prepare the pot, consecrated more than a thousand times.

6.s:
sahasraṃ homayettatra tato japtvā visarjayet
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ pūrṇaṃ paścādyajanamārabhet
6.d:
सहस्रं होमयेत्तत्र ततो जप्त्वा विसर्जयेत्
शतमष्टोत्तरं पूर्णं पश्चाद्यजनमारभेत्
6.m: He should offer one thousand oblations therein, and having recited [the mantra], he should dismiss [it]; / [reciting] a full one hundred and eight times, he should begin the sacrifice afterwards.

6.s:
tatrādau kumbhamādāya hemādimayamavraṇam
sarvamantrauṣadhīgarbhaṃ gandhāmbuparipūritam
6.d:
तत्रादौ कुम्भमादाय हेमादिमयमव्रणम्
सर्वमन्त्रौषधीगर्भं गन्धाम्बुपरिपूरितम्
6.m: There, first taking a jar made of gold or the like, unblemished, / containing within it all mantras and herbs, filled with fragrant water,

6.s:
cūtapallavavaktraṃ ca saksūtrasitakaṇṭhakam
rakṣonnatilakākrāntaṃ sitavastrayugāvṛtam
6.d:
चूतपल्लववक्त्रं च सक्सूत्रसितकण्ठकम्
रक्षोन्नतिलकाक्रान्तं सितवस्त्रयुगावृतम्
6.m: having its mouth [adorned with] mango sprouts, its neck white with garlands and threads, / marked with a tilaka that destroys demons, covered with a pair of white cloths,

6.s:
śatāṣṭottarasaṃjñaṃ mūlamantraprapūjitam
vārdhānyapi tathābhūtā kiṃtu sāstreṇa pūjitā
6.d:
शताष्टोत्तरसंज्ञं मूलमन्त्रप्रपूजितम्
वार्धान्यपि तथाभूता किंतु सास्त्रेण पूजिता
6.m: consecrated by chanting one hundred and eight times, worshiped with the root-mantra; / and the vardhanī vessel likewise, but worshiped with the weapon;

6.s:
vikirairāsanaṃ dattvā pūrvoktaṃ tu vicakṣaṇaḥ
indrādīnpūjayetpaścātsvadikṣu proktasasvaraiḥ
6.d:
विकिरैरासनं दत्त्वा पूर्वोक्तं तु विचक्षणः
इन्द्रादीन्पूजयेत्पश्चात्स्वदिक्षु प्रोक्तसस्वरैः
6.m: the wise one, having provided the previously taught seat with scatterings, / should then worship Indra and the others in their own directions with the vowels taught.

6.s:
avicchinnāṃ tato dhārāṃ vārdhānyā pratipādayet
bhrāmayetkalaśaṃ paścādbrūyāllokeśvarānidam
6.d:
अविच्छिन्नां ततो धारां वार्धान्या प्रतिपादयेत्
भ्रामयेत्कलशं पश्चाद्ब्रूयाल्लोकेश्वरानिदम्
6.m: Then he should offer an unbroken stream with the vardhanī vessel; / afterwards he should rotate the pot and say this to the world-guardians:

6.s:
bho bhoḥ śakra tvayā svasyāṃ diśi vighnapraśāntaye
sāvadhānena karmāntaṃ bhavitavyaṃ śivājñayā
6.d:
भो भोः शक्र त्वया स्वस्यां दिशि विघ्नप्रशान्तये
सावधानेन कर्मान्तं भवितव्यं शिवाज्ञया
6.m: “O Indra, O Indra! By the command of Śiva, you must remain attentive / in your own direction until the completion of the rite, for the pacification of obstacles!”

6.s:
nītvā tatrāsane pūrvaṃ mūrtibhūtaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset
tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge vārdhānīṃ viniveśayet
6.d:
नीत्वा तत्रासने पूर्वं मूर्तिभूतं घटं न्यसेत्
तस्य दक्षिणदिग्भागे वार्धानीं विनिवेशयेत्
6.m: Bringing it there, he should first place the jar, which has become the embodiment, on the seat; / in the southern section of it he should place the vardhanī vessel.

6.s:
ātmamūrtyādipūjyāntaṃ kumbhe vinyasya mantravit
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya vārdhānyāṃ pūjayedimam
6.d:
आत्ममूर्त्यादिपूज्यान्तं कुम्भे विन्यस्य मन्त्रवित्
गन्धपुष्पादिभिः पूज्य वार्धान्यां पूजयेदिमम्
6.m: The knower of mantras, having deposited [the entities] beginning with Ātman and the form up to the worshipable [deity] into the jar, / and having worshiped with perfumes, flowers, and the like, should worship this [weapon] in the vardhanī vessel.

6.s:
gandhairmaṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā brahmasthāne vicakṣaṇaḥ
tatra saṃpūjayetṣaṭkaṃ trikaṃ vāpyekameva vā
6.d:
गन्धैर्मण्डलकं कृत्वा ब्रह्मस्थाने विचक्षणः
तत्र संपूजयेत्षट्कं त्रिकं वाप्येकमेव वा
6.m: Having made a small maṇḍala with perfumes in the place of Brahmā, the wise one / should worship there the sextet, or the triad, or even the single one.

6.s:
kuṇḍasyollekhanaṃ lekhaḥ kuṭṭanaṃ copalepanam
catuṣpathākṣavāṭaṃ ca vajrasaṃsthāpanaṃ tathā
6.d:
कुण्डस्योल्लेखनं लेखः कुट्टनं चोपलेपनम्
चतुष्पथाक्षवाटं च वज्रसंस्थापनं तथा
6.m: The sketching of the fire-pit, drawing lines, beating down, and smearing, / the four-way crossroads, the fence, and the setting up of the thunderbolts,

6.s:
kuśāstaraṇaparidhiviṣṭarāṇāṃ ca kalpanam
sarvamastreṇa kurvīta vidyāmoṃhīmiti nyaset
6.d:
कुशास्तरणपरिधिविष्टराणां च कल्पनम्
सर्वमस्त्रेण कुर्वीत विद्यामोंहीमिति न्यसेत्
6.m: and the arranging of the scattering of kuśa grass, enclosing sticks, and grass mats— / he should do all with the weapon; he should deposit the Vidyā with 'oṃ hrīm'.

6.s:
śivamomiti vinyasya saṃpūjya dvitayaṃ punaḥ
tāmrapātre śarāve vā ānayejjātavedasam
6.d:
शिवमोमिति विन्यस्य संपूज्य द्वितयं पुनः
ताम्रपात्रे शरावे वा आनयेज्जातवेदसम्
6.m: Having deposited Śiva with 'om' and having worshiped the pair again, / he should bring the fire in a copper vessel or in an earthen dish.

6.s:
śivaśukramiti dhyātvā vidyāyonau vinikṣipet
tatastvāhūtayaḥ pañca vidyāṅgairaiva homayet
6.d:
शिवशुक्रमिति ध्यात्वा विद्यायोनौ विनिक्षिपेत्
ततस्त्वाहूतयः पञ्च विद्याङ्गैरैव होमयेत्
6.m: Meditating upon it as the semen of Śiva, he should cast it into the womb of Vidyā; / then he should offer five oblations with the limbs of the Vidyā alone.

6.s:
jananādi tataḥ karma sarvamevaṃkṛte kṛtam
parāparāmanusmṛtya dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ punaḥ
6.d:
जननादि ततः कर्म सर्वमेवंकृते कृतम्
परापरामनुस्मृत्य दद्यात्पूर्णाहुतिं पुनः
6.m: Then every rite beginning with birth is completed when this is done; / having remembered Parāparā, he should then offer the full oblation.

6.s:
saṃpūjya mātaraṃ vanheḥ pitaraṃ ca visarjayet
carvādisādhanāyāgniṃ samuddhṛtya tataḥ punaḥ
6.d:
संपूज्य मातरं वन्हेः पितरं च विसर्जयेत्
चर्वादिसाधनायाग्निं समुद्धृत्य ततः पुनः
6.m: Having worshiped the mother and father of the fire, he should dismiss them. / Then, taking up the fire again for the preparation of the cooked offering and the like,

6.s:
jvalitasyāthavā vanhermūrtiṃ vāmena vāyunā
ākṛṣya hṛdi saṃkumbhya dakṣiṇena punaḥ kṣipet
6.d:
ज्वलितस्याथवा वन्हेर्मूर्तिं वामेन वायुना
आकृष्य हृदि संकुम्भ्य दक्षिणेन पुनः क्षिपेत्
6.m: or drawing the pile of ignited fire with the left breath, / retaining it in the heart, he should release it again through the right [breath],

6.s:
pūrṇāṃ ca pūrvavaddadyācchivāgneraparo vidhiḥ
śivarūpaṃ tamālokya tasyātmāntaḥkṛtiḥ kramāt 117
kuryādantaḥkṛtiṃ mantrī tato homaṃ samārabhet
mūlaṃ śatena saṃtarpya tadaṅgāni ṣaḍaṅgataḥ
6.d:
पूर्णां च पूर्ववद्दद्याच्छिवाग्नेरपरो विधिः
शिवरूपं तमालोक्य तस्यात्मान्तःकृतिः क्रमात् 117
कुर्यादन्तःकृतिं मन्त्री ततो होमं समारभेत्
मूलं शतेन संतर्प्य तदङ्गानि षडङ्गतः
6.m:
and offer the full oblation as before; this is another rule for the Śiva-fire. / Having perceived it as having the form of Śiva, its internalization occurs gradually;

the practitioner of mantras should perform internalization, and then commence the oblation: / gratifying the root [mantra] with one hundred [oblations], and its limbs with the six limbs.

6.s:
śeṣāṇāṃ mantrajātīnāṃ deśāṃśenaiva tarpaṇam
tataḥ praveśayecchiṣyāñśucīnsnātānupoṣitān
6.d:
शेषाणां मन्त्रजातीनां देशांशेनैव तर्पणम्
ततः प्रवेशयेच्छिष्याञ्शुचीन्स्नातानुपोषितान्
6.m: The satisfaction of the remaining groups of mantras is done with only a tenth portion. / Then he should introduce the disciples, pure, bathed, and having fasted,

6.s:
praṇamya devadeveśaṃ catuṣṭayagataṃ kramāt
pañcagavyaṃ caruṃ dadyāddantadhāvanameva ca
6.d:
प्रणम्य देवदेवेशं चतुष्टयगतं क्रमात्
पञ्चगव्यं चरुं दद्याद्दन्तधावनमेव च
6.m: Having bowed in turn to the God of Gods situated in the tetrad. / He should give [them] the five products of the cow, the oblation, and tooth-cleansing [sticks].

6.s:
hṛdayena caroḥ siddhiryājñikaiḥ kṣīrataṇḍulaiḥ
saṃpātaṃ saptabhirmantraistataḥ ṣaḍbhāgabhājitam
6.d:
हृदयेन चरोः सिद्धिर्याज्ञिकैः क्षीरतण्डुलैः
संपातं सप्तभिर्मन्त्रैस्ततः षड्भागभाजितम्
6.m: The preparation of the oblation is done with the Heart mantra, using sacrificial milk and husked rice grains; / [and] libation drops with the seven mantras; then it is distributed into six portions,

6.s:
śivāgniguruśiṣyāṇāṃ vārdhanīkumbhayoḥ samam
dantakāṣṭhaṃ tato dadyātkṣīravṛkṣasamudbhavam
6.d:
शिवाग्निगुरुशिष्याणां वार्धनीकुम्भयोः समम्
दन्तकाष्ठं ततो दद्यात्क्षीरवृक्षसमुद्भवम्
6.m: Equally for Śiva, the fire, the guru, the disciples, and the Vardhanī and kumbha [vessels]. / Then he should give the tooth-cleansing stick, produced from a milky sap tree.

6.s:
tasya pātaḥ śubhaḥ prācīsaumyaiśyāpyordhvadiggataḥ
aśubho'nyatra tatrāpi homo'ṣṭaśatiko bhavet
6.d:
तस्य पातः शुभः प्राचीसौम्यैश्याप्योर्ध्वदिग्गतः
अशुभोऽन्यत्र तत्रापि होमोऽष्टशतिको भवेत्
6.m: Its fall is auspicious toward the east, north, northeast, and upward directions; / it is inauspicious elsewhere; even in that case, there should be an offering of one hundred and eight [oblations].

6.s:
bahiḥkarma tataḥ kuryāddikṣu sarvāsu daiśikaḥ
oṃ kṣaḥ kṣaḥ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ svāheti manunāmunā
6.d:
बहिःकर्म ततः कुर्याद्दिक्षु सर्वासु दैशिकः
ओं क्षः क्षः सर्वभूतेभ्यः स्वाहेति मनुनामुना
6.m: Then the master should perform the exterior rite in all directions / with this mantra: "Oṃ kṣaḥ kṣaḥ, to all beings, svāhā!"

6.s:
samācamya kṛtanyāsaḥ samabhyarcya ca śaṅkaram
.... .... ................gṛha śuciḥ
6.d:
समाचम्य कृतन्यासः समभ्यर्च्य च शङ्करम्
॥॥ ॥॥ ॥॥॥॥॥॥॥॥गृह शुचिः
6.m: Having sipped water, made the imposition, and worshiped Śaṅkara, / […] pure in the house.

6.s:
nyāsaṃ kṛtvā tu śiṣyāṇāmātmanaśca viśeṣataḥ
prabhāte nityakarmādi kṛtvā svapnaṃ vicārayet
6.d:
न्यासं कृत्वा तु शिष्याणामात्मनश्च विशेषतः
प्रभाते नित्यकर्मादि कृत्वा स्वप्नं विचारयेत्
6.m: Having performed the imposition for the disciples, and especially for himself, / in the morning, having performed the regular rites and so on, he should examine their dreams.

6.s:
śubhaṃ prakāśayetteṣāmaśubhe homamācaret
tataḥ puṣpaphalādīnāṃ suveśābharaṇāḥ striyaḥ
6.d:
शुभं प्रकाशयेत्तेषामशुभे होममाचरेत्
ततः पुष्पफलादीनां सुवेशाभरणाः स्त्रियः
6.m: He should explain the auspicious [dreams] to them, and in the case of inauspicious [dreams], perform fire-sacrifice. / Then, [dreams of] flowers, fruits, and the like; women beautifully dressed and adorned;

6.s:
āpaduttaraṇaṃ caiva śubhadeśāvarohaṇam
madyapānaṃ śiraśchedamāmamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇam
6.d:
आपदुत्तरणं चैव शुभदेशावरोहणम्
मद्यपानं शिरश्छेदमाममांसस्य भक्षणम्
6.m: Crossing over dangers; descending onto auspicious places; / drinking liquor; decapitation; eating raw meat;

6.s:
devatādarśanaṃ sākṣāttathā viṣṭhānulepanam
evaṃvidhaṃ śubhaṃ dṛṣṭvā siddhiṃ prāpnotyabhīpsitām
6.d:
देवतादर्शनं साक्षात्तथा विष्ठानुलेपनम्
एवंविधं शुभं दृष्ट्वा सिद्धिं प्राप्नोत्यभीप्सिताम्
6.m: Seeing a deity in person; and anointing oneself with feces: / having seen auspicious [dreams] of such kinds, one attains the desired attainment.

6.s:
etadevānyathābhūtaṃ duḥsvapna iti kīrtyate
pakvamāṃsāśanābhyaṅgagartādipatanādikam
6.d:
एतदेवान्यथाभूतं दुःस्वप्न इति कीर्त्यते
पक्वमांसाशनाभ्यङ्गगर्तादिपतनादिकम्
6.m: The contrary of these is declared to be a bad dream: / eating cooked meat; applying oil rubs; falling into pits and the like.

6.s:
tatroktāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ kṛtvā dvijatvāpādanaṃ tataḥ
devāgnigurudevīnāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā sadā budhaḥ
6.d:
तत्रोक्तां निष्कृतिं कृत्वा द्विजत्वापादनं ततः
देवाग्निगुरुदेवीनां पूजां कृत्वा सदा बुधः
6.m: Having performed the expiation taught in the tantra, then producing twice-born status, / the wise one should always worship the deity, the fire, the guru, and the goddesses.

6.s:
eteṣāmanivedyaiva na kiṃcidapi bhakṣayet
devadravyaṃ gurudravyaṃ caṇḍīdravyaṃ ca varjayet
6.d:
एतेषामनिवेद्यैव न किंचिदपि भक्षयेत्
देवद्रव्यं गुरुद्रव्यं चण्डीद्रव्यं च वर्जयेत्
6.m: Without having offered to these, he should not eat anything at all. / He must avoid the property of the deity, the property of the guru, and the property of Caṇḍī.

6.s:
niṣphalaṃ naiva ceṣṭeta muhūrtamapi mantravit
yogābhyāsarato bhūyānmantrābhyāsarato'pi vā
6.d:
निष्फलं नैव चेष्टेत मुहूर्तमपि मन्त्रवित्
योगाभ्यासरतो भूयान्मन्त्राभ्यासरतोऽपि वा
6.m: The knower of mantras should never act fruitlessly even for a muhūrta; / he should be devoted to the practice of yoga, or devoted to the practice of mantras.

6.s:
ityevamādisamayāñśrāvayitvā visarjayet
devadevaṃ tataḥ snānaṃ śiṣyāṇāmātmano'pi vā
6.d:
इत्येवमादिसमयाञ्श्रावयित्वा विसर्जयेत्
देवदेवं ततः स्नानं शिष्याणामात्मनोऽपि वा
6.m: Having recited rules of conduct such as these, he should dismiss / the God of Gods. Then [he should perform] a bath for the disciples, or for himself,

6.s:
kārayecchivakumbhena sarvaduṣkṛtahāriṇā
ityetatsāmayaṃ karma samāsātparikīrtitam
iti śrīmālinīvijayottare tantre samayādhikāro'ṣṭamaḥ
6.d:
कारयेच्छिवकुम्भेन सर्वदुष्कृतहारिणा
इत्येतत्सामयं कर्म समासात्परिकीर्तितम्
इति श्रीमालिनीविजयोत्तरे तन्त्रे समयाधिकारोऽष्टमः
6.m:
He should have them perform it with the jar of Śiva, which removes all bad deeds. / Thus, this ritual of the rules of conduct has been concisely proclaimed.

Thus ends the eighth chapter, the Scope of Rules of Conduct, in the venerable Mālinīvijayottara.

7.s:
athaiṣāṃ samayasthānāṃ kuryāddīkṣāṃ yadā guruḥ
tathādhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā......................
7.d:
अथैषां समयस्थानां कुर्याद्दीक्षां यदा गुरुः
तथाधिवासनं कृत्वा॥॥॥॥॥॥॥॥॥॥॥
7.m: Now, when the guru performs initiation for those who abide by these rules of conduct, / then, having performed the preliminary consecration […]

7.s:
sa ca pūrvā diśaṃ samyak sūtramāsphālayettataḥ
tanmadhyātpūrvavāruṇyāvaṅkayetaṃ samāntaram
7.d:
स च पूर्वा दिशं सम्यक् सूत्रमास्फालयेत्ततः
तन्मध्यात्पूर्ववारुण्यावङ्कयेतं समान्तरम्
7.m: And he should first snap the cord properly along the [cardinal] direction. / From its middle, he should mark off an equal distance along the east-west [line].

7.s:
pūrvāparasamāsena sūtreṇottaradakṣiṇam
aṅkyedaparādaṅgātpūrvādapi tathaiva te
7.d:
पूर्वापरसमासेन सूत्रेणोत्तरदक्षिणम्
अङ्क्येदपरादङ्गात्पूर्वादपि तथैव ते
7.m: With a cord combined of east and west, he should mark off the north and south. / From the western mark and likewise from the eastern mark,

7.s:
matsyamadhye kṣipetsūtramāyataṃ dakṣiṇottare
matakṣetrārdhamānena madhyāddikṣvaṅkayetsamam
7.d:
मत्स्यमध्ये क्षिपेत्सूत्रमायतं दक्षिणोत्तरे
मतक्षेत्रार्धमानेन मध्याद्दिक्ष्वङ्कयेत्समम्
7.m: He should cast a cord stretched out south to north in the middle of the fish [figure]. / By the measure of half the desired area, he should mark equally from the center toward the cardinal directions.

7.s:
tadvaddiksthācca koṇeṣu anulomavilomataḥ
pātayetteṣu sūtrāṇi caturaśraprasiddhaye
7.d:
तद्वद्दिक्स्थाच्च कोणेषु अनुलोमविलोमतः
पातयेत्तेषु सूत्राणि चतुरश्रप्रसिद्धये
7.m: Likewise, from the cardinal points to the corners, in direct and reverse order, / he should drop cords across them to produce a square.

7.s:
vedāśrite hi haste prāk pūrvamardhaṃ vibhājayet
hastārdhaṃ sarvatastyaktvā pūrvodaggrāmadiggatam
7.d:
वेदाश्रिते हि हस्ते प्राक् पूर्वमर्धं विभाजयेत्
हस्तार्धं सर्वतस्त्यक्त्वा पूर्वोदग्ग्रामदिग्गतम्
7.m: In a cubit having four corners, he should first divide the eastern half, / having discarded half a cubit all around in the east, north, and south directions.

7.s:
guṇāṅgulasamairbhāgaiḥ śeṣamasya vibhājayet
tryaṅgulaiḥ koṣṭhakairūrdhvaistiryak cāṣṭadvidhātmakaiḥ
7.d:
गुणाङ्गुलसमैर्भागैः शेषमस्य विभाजयेत्
त्र्यङ्गुलैः कोष्ठकैरूर्ध्वैस्तिर्यक् चाष्टद्विधात्मकैः
7.m: He should divide the remainder of this into parts equal to three finger-breadths, / with vertical compartments of three finger-breadths, and sixteen horizontally.

7.s:
dvau dvau bhāgau parityajya punardakṣiṇasaumyagau
brahmaṇaḥ pārśvayorjīvāccaturthātpūrvatastathā
7.d:
द्वौ द्वौ भागौ परित्यज्य पुनर्दक्षिणसौम्यगौ
ब्रह्मणः पार्श्वयोर्जीवाच्चतुर्थात्पूर्वतस्तथा
7.m: Leaving aside two portions each situated in the south and the north, / on both sides of the central line, from the chord from the fourth [compartment] toward the east,

7.s:
bhāgārdhabhāgamānaṃ tu khaṇḍacandradvayaṃ dvayam
tayorantastṛtīye tu dakṣiṇottarapārśvayoḥ
7.d:
भागार्धभागमानं तु खण्डचन्द्रद्वयं द्वयम्
तयोरन्तस्तृतीये तु दक्षिणोत्तरपार्श्वयोः
7.m: Two crescent moons each measuring half a portion [should be made]. / Inside them, in the third, on the south and north sides,

7.s:
jīve khaṇḍenduyugalaṃ kuryādantarbhramādbudhaḥ
tayoraparamarmasthaṃ khaṇḍendudvayakoṭigam
7.d:
जीवे खण्डेन्दुयुगलं कुर्यादन्तर्भ्रमाद्बुधः
तयोरपरमर्मस्थं खण्डेन्दुद्वयकोटिगम्
7.m: On the chord, the wise one should make a pair of crescent moons by inward rotation. / Situated on the western junction of those two, reaching the tips of the two crescent moons,

7.s:
bahirmukhabhramaṃ kuryāt khaṇḍacandradvayaṃ dvayam
tadbrahmaṇi kurvīta bhāgabhāgārdhasaṃmitam
7.d:
बहिर्मुखभ्रमं कुर्यात् खण्डचन्द्रद्वयं द्वयम्
तद्ब्रह्मणि कुर्वीत भागभागार्धसंमितम्
7.m: He should make two crescent moons each with outward rotation. / In the same manner, he should make [them] on the central line, measuring one and a half portions.

7.s:
tato dvitīyabhāgānte brahmaṇaḥ pārśvayordvayoḥ
dve rekhe pūrvage neye bhāgatryaṃśaśame budhaiḥ
7.d:
ततो द्वितीयभागान्ते ब्रह्मणः पार्श्वयोर्द्वयोः
द्वे रेखे पूर्वगे नेये भागत्र्यंशशमे बुधैः
7.m: Then, at the end of the second portion, on both sides of the central line, / two lines extending east should be drawn by the wise, equal to a third of a portion.

7.s:
ekārdhendūrdhvakoṭisthaṃ brahmasūtrāgrasaṃgatam
sūtradvayaṃ prakurvīta madhyaśṛṅgaprasiddhaye
7.d:
एकार्धेन्दूर्ध्वकोटिस्थं ब्रह्मसूत्राग्रसंगतम्
सूत्रद्वयं प्रकुर्वीत मध्यशृङ्गप्रसिद्धये
7.m: Situated on the upper tip of one half-moon, meeting the end of the central cord, / he should draw two cords to form the central prong.

7.s:
tadagrapārśvayorjīvātsūtramekāntare śritam
ādidvitīyakhaṇḍendukoṇātkoṇāntamāśrayet
7.d:
तदग्रपार्श्वयोर्जीवात्सूत्रमेकान्तरे श्रितम्
आदिद्वितीयखण्डेन्दुकोणात्कोणान्तमाश्रयेत्
7.m: From the chord beside its tip, resting at an interval of one, / he should draw [a line] from corner to corner of the first and second crescent moon.

7.s:
tayorevāparājjīvātprathamārdhendukoṇataḥ
tadvadeva nayetsūtraṃ śṛṅgadvitayasiddhaye
7.d:
तयोरेवापराज्जीवात्प्रथमार्धेन्दुकोणतः
तद्वदेव नयेत्सूत्रं शृङ्गद्वितयसिद्धये
7.m: From the western chord of those two, from the corner of the first half-moon, / in just that way he should draw a cord to produce the two [outer] prongs.

7.s:
kṣetrārdhe cāpare daṇḍo dvikaracchannapañcakaḥ
dvikaraṃ pañca tadbhāgāḥ pañcapīṭhatirohitāḥ
7.d:
क्षेत्रार्धे चापरे दण्डो द्विकरच्छन्नपञ्चकः
द्विकरं पञ्च तद्भागाः पञ्चपीठतिरोहिताः
7.m: And in the other half of the area, there is a shaft of two cubits, covering five [units]; / measuring two cubits, five parts of it are hidden by five pedestals.

7.s:
śeṣamanyaddraveddūdṛśyaṃ pṛthutvādbhāgasaṃmitam
ṣaḍvistṛtaṃ caturdīrgha tadadho'malasārakam
7.d:
शेषमन्यद्द्रवेद्दूदृश्यं पृथुत्वाद्भागसंमितम्
षड्विस्तृतं चतुर्दीर्घ तदधोऽमलसारकम्
7.m: The rest will be visible, measuring one portion in width. / Below it is a cap, six [finger-breadths] wide and four long.

7.s:
vedāṅgulaṃ ca tadadho mūlaṃ tīkṣṇāgramiṣyate
ādikṣetrasya kurvīta dikṣu dvāracatuṣṭayam
7.d:
वेदाङ्गुलं च तदधो मूलं तीक्ष्णाग्रमिष्यते
आदिक्षेत्रस्य कुर्वीत दिक्षु द्वारचतुष्टयम्
7.m: And below it is the base, four finger-breadths [wide], desired to have a sharp tip. / In the primary field, he should make four doors in the cardinal directions,

7.s:
hastāyāmaṃ tadardhaṃ tu vistārādapi tatsamam
dviguṇaṃ bāhyataḥ kuryāttataḥ padmaṃ yathā śṛṇu
7.d:
हस्तायामं तदर्धं तु विस्तारादपि तत्समम्
द्विगुणं बाह्यतः कुर्यात्ततः पद्मं यथा शृणु
7.m: One cubit long, and half of that in width, equal to the entrance. / He should make it double on the outside; then listen to how [to draw] the lotus.

7.s:
ekaikabhāgamānāni kuryādvṛttāni vedavat
dikṣvaṣṭau punarapyaṣṭau jīvasūtrāṇi ṣoḍaśa
7.d:
एकैकभागमानानि कुर्याद्वृत्तानि वेदवत्
दिक्ष्वष्टौ पुनरप्यष्टौ जीवसूत्राणि षोडश
7.m: He should make four concentric circles, measuring one portion each; / eight in the directions, and eight more, making sixteen chord-lines.

7.s:
dvayordvayoḥ punarmadhye tatsaṃkhyātāni pātayet
eṣāṃ tṛtīyavṛttasthaṃ pārśvajīvasamaṃ bhramam
7.d:
द्वयोर्द्वयोः पुनर्मध्ये तत्संख्यातानि पातयेत्
एषां तृतीयवृत्तस्थं पार्श्वजीवसमं भ्रमम्
7.m: Between every two, he should again cast an equal number. / Of these, situated in the third circle, equal to the adjacent chord, a circle [is drawn].

7.s:
etadantaṃ prakurvīta tato jīvāgramānayet
yatraiva kutracitsaṅgastatsaṃbandhe sthirīkṛte
7.d:
एतदन्तं प्रकुर्वीत ततो जीवाग्रमानयेत्
यत्रैव कुत्रचित्सङ्गस्तत्संबन्धे स्थिरीकृते
7.m: He should extend it to this limit; then he should bring the tip of the chord. / Wherever there is contact, once that connection is fixed,

7.s:
tatra kṛtvā nayenmantrī patrāgrāṇāṃ prasiddhaye
ekaikasmindale kuryātkesarāṇāṃ trayaṃ trayam
7.d:
तत्र कृत्वा नयेन्मन्त्री पत्राग्राणां प्रसिद्धये
एकैकस्मिन्दले कुर्यात्केसराणां त्रयं त्रयम्
7.m: Placing it there, the practitioner of mantras should extend it to form the petal tips. / On each petal, he should make three filaments each.

7.s:
dviguṇāṣṭāṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ tadvacchṛṅgajatrayam
tataḥ prapūjayenmantrī rajobhiḥ sitapūrakaiḥ
7.d:
द्विगुणाष्टाङ्गुलं कार्यं तद्वच्छृङ्गजत्रयम्
ततः प्रपूजयेन्मन्त्री रजोभिः सितपूरकैः
7.m: The three prongs should be made measuring sixteen finger-breadths in the same way. / Then the practitioner of mantras should worship with white filling powders,

7.s:
raktaiḥ kṛṣṇaistathā pītairharitaiśca viśeṣataḥ
karṇikā pītavarṇana mūlamadhyāgradeśataḥ
7.d:
रक्तैः कृष्णैस्तथा पीतैर्हरितैश्च विशेषतः
कर्णिका पीतवर्णन मूलमध्याग्रदेशतः
7.m: With red, black, and yellow, and especially with green. / The pericarp is yellow in color; from the base, middle, and tip,

7.s:
sitaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kāryaṃ kesarajālakam
dalāni śuklavarṇāni prativāraṇayā saha
7.d:
सितं रक्तं तथा पीतं कार्यं केसरजालकम्
दलानि शुक्लवर्णानि प्रतिवारणया सह
7.m: White, red, and yellow is the network of filaments to be made. / The petals are white in color, together with a protective border.

7.s:
pītaṃ tadvaccatuṣkoṇaṃ karṇikārdhasamaṃ bahiḥ
sitaraktapītakṛṣṇaistatpādānvahitaḥ kramāt
7.d:
पीतं तद्वच्चतुष्कोणं कर्णिकार्धसमं बहिः
सितरक्तपीतकृष्णैस्तत्पादान्वहितः क्रमात्
7.m: Likewise, a yellow square is on the outside, equal to half the pericarp. / With white, red, yellow, and black, [he colors] its feet in sequence, starting from the fire [corner].

7.s:
caturbhirapi śṛṅgāṇi tribhirmaṇḍalamiṣyate
daṇḍaḥ syānnīlaraktena pītamāmalasārakam
7.d:
चतुर्भिरपि शृङ्गाणि त्रिभिर्मण्डलमिष्यते
दण्डः स्यान्नीलरक्तेन पीतमामलसारकम्
7.m: The prongs [are colored] with all four, and the circular zone is taught with three. / The shaft should be blue and red, and the cap yellow.

7.s:
raktaṃ śūlaṃ prakurvīta yattatpūrvaṃ prakalpitam
paścāddvārasya pūrveṇa tyaktvāṅgulacatuṣṭayam
7.d:
रक्तं शूलं प्रकुर्वीत यत्तत्पूर्वं प्रकल्पितम्
पश्चाद्द्वारस्य पूर्वेण त्यक्त्वाङ्गुलचतुष्टयम्
7.m: He should make the trident red, which was designed earlier. / Behind the door, having left four finger-breadths to the east,

7.s:
dvāraṃ vedāśri vṛttaṃ vā saṃkīrṇaṃ vā vicitritam
ekadvitripuraṃ tulyaṃ sāmudramatha vobhayam
7.d:
द्वारं वेदाश्रि वृत्तं वा संकीर्णं वा विचित्रितम्
एकद्वित्रिपुरं तुल्यं सामुद्रमथ वोभयम्
7.m: A door that is square or round, or composite, or variegated, / with one, two, or three tiers, equal, shaped like a box, or both,

7.s:
kapālakaṇṭhaśobhopaśobhādibahucitritam
vicitrākārasaṃsthānaṃ vallīsūkṣmagṛhānvitam
7.d:
कपालकण्ठशोभोपशोभादिबहुचित्रितम्
विचित्राकारसंस्थानं वल्लीसूक्ष्मगृहान्वितम्
7.m: Diversely decorated with the ornament of a skull, a neck, and secondary ornaments, / of varied shape and design, provided with creepers and small chambers.

7.s:
evamatra suniṣpanne gandhavastreṇa mārjanam
kṛtvā snānaṃ prakurvīta pūrvoktenaiva karmaṇā
7.d:
एवमत्र सुनिष्पन्ने गन्धवस्त्रेण मार्जनम्
कृत्वा स्नानं प्रकुर्वीत पूर्वोक्तेनैव कर्मणा
7.m: When this is thoroughly accomplished here, after wiping [the ground] with fragrant cloth, / he should perform the bath according to the procedure stated earlier.

7.s:
praviśya pūrvavanmantrī upaviśya yathā purā
nyasya pūrvoditaṃ sarvaṃ pañcadhā bhairavātmakam
7.d:
प्रविश्य पूर्ववन्मन्त्री उपविश्य यथा पुरा
न्यस्य पूर्वोदितं सर्वं पञ्चधा भैरवात्मकम्
7.m: Entering as before and sitting as previously, the practitioner of mantras, / having imposed all that was previously taught, twofold and fivefold, embodying Bhairava,

7.s:
uttare vinyasecchṛṅge devadevaṃ navātmakam
madhye bhairavasadbhāvaṃ dakṣiṇe ratiśekharam
7.d:
उत्तरे विन्यसेच्छृङ्गे देवदेवं नवात्मकम्
मध्ये भैरवसद्भावं दक्षिणे रतिशेखरम्
7.m: should place the God of gods, Navātman, on the northern horn, / the essence of Bhairava in the middle, and Ratiśekhara on the right.

7.s:
raktatvagmāṃsasūtraistu vāmakarṇavibhūṣitam
binduyuktaṃ prameyotaṃ ratiśekharamādiśet
7.d:
रक्तत्वग्मांससूत्रैस्तु वामकर्णविभूषितम्
बिन्दुयुक्तं प्रमेयोतं रतिशेखरमादिशेत्
7.m: Adorned with blood, skin, flesh, and thread, and embellished with the left ear, / endowed with a drop, Ratiśekhara is declared as the established object.

7.s:
śāktaṃ ca pūrvavatkṛtvā tarpayetpūrvavadbudhaḥ
punarabhyarcya deveśaṃ bhaktyā vijñāpayedidam
7.d:
शाक्तं च पूर्ववत्कृत्वा तर्पयेत्पूर्ववद्बुधः
पुनरभ्यर्च्य देवेशं भक्त्या विज्ञापयेदिदम्
7.m: Having performed the śākta [rite] as before, the wise one should offer libations as before; / worshipping the Lord of gods again, he should address this with devotion:

7.s:
gurutvena tvayaivāhamājñāpataḥ parameśvara
anugrāhyāstvayā śiṣyāḥ śivaśaktipracoditāḥ
7.d:
गुरुत्वेन त्वयैवाहमाज्ञापतः परमेश्वर
अनुग्राह्यास्त्वया शिष्याः शिवशक्तिप्रचोदिताः
7.m: “O Supreme Lord, I have been commanded by you alone to act as guru: / ‘The disciples prompted by the Śiva-śakti are to be favored by you.’

7.s:
tadete tadvidhāḥ prāptāstvameṣāṃ kurvvanugraham
madīyāṃ tanumāviśya yenāhaṃ tvatsamo bhavan
7.d:
तदेते तद्विधाः प्राप्तास्त्वमेषां कुर्व्वनुग्रहम्
मदीयां तनुमाविश्य येनाहं त्वत्समो भवन्
7.m: Therefore, these disciples of such kind have arrived; grant your favor to them, / having entered my body, so that, becoming equal to you,

7.s:
karomyevamiti prokto harṣādutphullalocanaḥ
tataḥ ṣaḍvidhamadhvānamanenādhiṣṭhitaṃ smaret
7.d:
करोम्येवमिति प्रोक्तो हर्षादुत्फुल्ललोचनः
ततः षड्विधमध्वानमनेनाधिष्ठितं स्मरेत्
7.m: I may perform it thus.” Having spoken thus, his eyes blossoming with joy, / he should then contemplate the sixfold cosmic path as presided over by him.

7.s:
sṛṣṭyādipañcakarmāṇi niṣpādyānyasya cintayet
śaktibhirjīvamūrtiḥ syāddvidhaivāsya parāparā
7.d:
सृष्ट्यादिपञ्चकर्माणि निष्पाद्यान्यस्य चिन्तयेत्
शक्तिभिर्जीवमूर्तिः स्याद्द्विधैवास्य परापरा
7.m: He should contemplate his five activities, beginning with creation, as to be accomplished; / through his powers his living form is twofold: supreme and subordinate.

7.s:
mūrtāmūrtatvabhedena māmapyeṣānutiṣṭhati
karaṇatvaṃ prayāntyasya mantrā ye hṛdayādayaḥ
7.d:
मूर्तामूर्तत्वभेदेन मामप्येषानुतिष्ठति
करणत्वं प्रयान्त्यस्य मन्त्रा ये हृदयादयः
7.m: Through the distinction between form and formlessness, this [power] attends upon me as well; / the mantras beginning with the Heart become its instruments.

7.s:
evaṃbhūtaṃ śivaṃ dhyātvā tadgatenāntarātmanā
bhāvyaṃ tanmayamātmānaṃ daśadhāvartayecchivam
7.d:
एवंभूतं शिवं ध्यात्वा तद्गतेनान्तरात्मना
भाव्यं तन्मयमात्मानं दशधावर्तयेच्छिवम्
7.m: Having meditated on Śiva who has become such, with his inner self absorbed in him, / meditating on himself as consisting of him, he should repeat Śiva ten times,

7.s:
triḥkṛtvā sarvamantrāṃśca garbhāvaraṇasaṃsthitān
sitoṣṇīṣaṃ tato baddhvā saptamasaṃ navātmanā
7.d:
त्रिःकृत्वा सर्वमन्त्रांश्च गर्भावरणसंस्थितान्
सितोष्णीषं ततो बद्ध्वा सप्तमसं नवात्मना
7.m: and three times all the mantras residing in the interior enclosures; / then, having perceived the white turban recited seven times with Navātman,

7.s:
śivahastaṃ tataḥ kuryātpāśaviśleṣakārakam
prakṣālya gandhatoyena hastaṃ hastena kenacit
7.d:
शिवहस्तं ततः कुर्यात्पाशविश्लेषकारकम्
प्रक्षाल्य गन्धतोयेन हस्तं हस्तेन केनचित्
7.m: he should then make the hand of Śiva, which brings about the severing of bonds. / Having washed one hand with the other with fragrant water,

7.s:
gandhadigdho yajeddevaṃ sāṅgamāsanavarjitam
ātmanyālabhanaṃ kuryādgrahaṇaṃ yojanaṃ tathā
7.d:
गन्धदिग्धो यजेद्देवं साङ्गमासनवर्जितम्
आत्मन्यालभनं कुर्याद्ग्रहणं योजनं तथा
7.m: smeared with perfume, he should worship the God with his limbs, omitting the seat; / he should perform the touching upon himself, the seizing, and the uniting,

7.s:
viyogaṃ ca tathoddhāraṃ pāśacchedādikaṃ ca yat
evaṃ patitvamāsādya prapañcavyāptitaḥ śivam
7.d:
वियोगं च तथोद्धारं पाशच्छेदादिकं च यत्
एवं पतित्वमासाद्य प्रपञ्चव्याप्तितः शिवम्
7.m: as well as the separation, extraction, and cutting of the bonds. / Having thus attained mastery, through his pervasion of the manifest world,

7.s:
bhāvayetpṛthagātmānaṃ tatsamānaguṇaṃ tataḥ
maṇḍalastho'hamevāryaṃ sākṣīvākhilakarmasu
7.d:
भावयेत्पृथगात्मानं तत्समानगुणं ततः
मण्डलस्थोऽहमेवार्यं साक्षीवाखिलकर्मसु
7.m: he should then contemplate his own self as distinct, possessing qualities equal to him: / “It is I myself who am in the maṇḍala, like a witness in all rituals;

7.s:
homādhikaraṇatvena vahnāvahamavasthitaḥ
āyāgāntamahaṃ kumbhe saṃsthito vighnaśāntaye
7.d:
होमाधिकरणत्वेन वह्नावहमवस्थितः
आयागान्तमहं कुम्भे संस्थितो विघ्नशान्तये
7.m: acting as the locus of oblation, I am situated in the fire; / I remain in the water vessel until the end of the sacrifice to pacify obstacles;

7.s:
śiṣyadehe ca tatpāśaviśleṣatvaprasiddhaye
sākṣātsvadehasaṃstho'haṃ kartānugrahakarmaṇaḥ
7.d:
शिष्यदेहे च तत्पाशविश्लेषत्वप्रसिद्धये
साक्षात्स्वदेहसंस्थोऽहं कर्तानुग्रहकर्मणः
7.m: and in the disciple's body, for the accomplishment of the severing of his bonds; / manifestly residing in my own body, I am the agent of the work of grace.”

7.s:
ityetatsarvamālocya śodhyādhvānaṃ vicintayet
dīkṣāṃ yenādhvanā mantrī śiṣyāṇāṃ kartumicchati
7.d:
इत्येतत्सर्वमालोच्य शोध्याध्वानं विचिन्तयेत्
दीक्षां येनाध्वना मन्त्री शिष्याणां कर्तुमिच्छति
7.m: Reflecting on all this, he should contemplate the cosmic path to be purified, / through which cosmic path the practitioner of mantras desires to perform initiation for the disciples.

7.s:
tatraivālocayetsarvaṃ yāyātpadamanāmayam
tatra tenāpṛthagbhūtvā punaḥ saṃcintayedidam
7.d:
तत्रैवालोचयेत्सर्वं यायात्पदमनामयम्
तत्र तेनापृथग्भूत्वा पुनः संचिन्तयेदिदम्
7.m: Right there he should contemplate everything, [so that the disciple] reaches the painless state; / becoming non-different from it there, he should again contemplate this:

7.s:
ahameva paraṃ tattvaṃ mayi sarvamidaṃ jagat
adhiṣṭhātā ca kartā ca sarvasyāhamavasthitaḥ
7.d:
अहमेव परं तत्त्वं मयि सर्वमिदं जगत्
अधिष्ठाता च कर्ता च सर्वस्याहमवस्थितः
7.m: “I alone am the supreme tattva; all this universe is in me; / I remain as the presiding lord and the maker of all.

7.s:
tatsamatavaṃ gato janturmukta ityabhidhīyate
evaṃ saṃcintya bhūyo'pi śodhyamādyaṃ samāśrayet
7.d:
तत्समतवं गतो जन्तुर्मुक्त इत्यभिधीयते
एवं संचिन्त्य भूयोऽपि शोध्यमाद्यं समाश्रयेत्
7.m: A living being who has attained equality with that is called liberated.” / Having contemplated thus, he should again resort to the first [station] to be purified.

7.s:
śiṣyamaṇḍalavahnīnāṃ tatraikaṃ bhāvayetsthitam
śodhyādhvānaṃ tu śiṣyāṇāṃ nyasya dehe puroktavat
7.d:
शिष्यमण्डलवह्नीनां तत्रैकं भावयेत्स्थितम्
शोध्याध्वानं तु शिष्याणां न्यस्य देहे पुरोक्तवत्
7.m: He should contemplate one [Śiva] residing in the disciple, the maṇḍala, and the fire; / having imposed the cosmic path to be purified on the disciple's body as stated before,

7.s:
svena svenaiva mantreṇa svavyāptidhyānamāśrayet
āgantu sahajaṃ śāktaṃ baddhādau pāśapañjaram
7.d:
स्वेन स्वेनैव मन्त्रेण स्वव्याप्तिध्यानमाश्रयेत्
आगन्तु सहजं शाक्तं बद्धादौ पाशपञ्जरम्
7.m: he should resort to the meditation on his own pervasion, each by its own mantra. / Having first understood the cage of bonds as adventitious, innate, and śākta,

7.s:
bāhukaṇṭhaśikhāgreṣu triṣu ( vṛta ) triguṇatantunā
svamantreṇa tatastattvamāvāhoṣṭvā pratarpya ca
7.d:
बाहुकण्ठशिखाग्रेषु त्रिषु ( वृत ) त्रिगुणतन्तुना
स्वमन्त्रेण ततस्तत्त्वमावाहोष्ट्वा प्रतर्प्य च
7.m: [wound] with a three-stranded cord on the three [places]—the arms, the throat, and the tip of the crest— / having then invoked, worshipped, and propitiated the tattva with its own mantra,

7.s:
tatastacchodhyayonīnāṃ vyāpinīṃ yonimānayet
māyānte'dhvani tāmeva śuddhe vidyāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ
7.d:
ततस्तच्छोध्ययोनीनां व्यापिनीं योनिमानयेत्
मायान्तेऽध्वनि तामेव शुद्धे विद्यां विचक्षणः
7.m: the discerning one should then bring the all-pervading womb among those wombs to be purified; / that very one at the cosmic path ending in Māyā, and Vidyā in the pure [realm].

7.s:
tasyāṃ saṃtarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā śiṣyamantreṇa tāḍayet
ālabhya hṛdaye vidvāñchicchvahastena taṃ punaḥ
7.d:
तस्यां संतर्पणं कृत्वा शिष्यमन्त्रेण ताडयेत्
आलभ्य हृदये विद्वाञ्छिच्छ्वहस्तेन तं पुनः
7.m: Having offered libation in it, he should strike the disciple with the Astra mantra; / touching him on the heart again with the hand of Śiva, the wise one

7.s:
grahaṇaṃ tasya kurvīta raśmimātrāviyogataḥ
nāḍīmārgeṇa gatvā tu haṃhanmantrapuṭīkṛtam
7.d:
ग्रहणं तस्य कुर्वीत रश्मिमात्रावियोगतः
नाडीमार्गेण गत्वा तु हंहन्मन्त्रपुटीकृतम्
7.m: should make the extraction of him through non-separation from the ray-measure alone; / having gone via the path of the channels, encased with the Haṃ-hṛd mantra,

7.s:
kṛtvātmasthaṃ tato yonau garbhādhānaṃ vicintayet
tryarṇādhārdhākṣarayā mantrī sarvagarbhakriyānvitam
7.d:
कृत्वात्मस्थं ततो योनौ गर्भाधानं विचिन्तयेत्
त्र्यर्णाधार्धाक्षरया मन्त्री सर्वगर्भक्रियान्वितम्
7.m: having placed him within himself, the practitioner of mantras should then contemplate conception in the womb / by means of the mantra of three and a half phonemes, accompanied by all the rites of the womb.

7.s:
bhogyabhoktṛtvasāmarthyaniṣpattyā jananaṃ budhaḥ
dakṣabhṛṅgasthayā mantrī prakurvīta sulocane
7.d:
भोग्यभोक्तृत्वसामर्थ्यनिष्पत्त्या जननं बुधः
दक्षभृङ्गस्थया मन्त्री प्रकुर्वीत सुलोचने
7.m: The wise practitioner of mantras, O fair-eyed one, should effect birth through the completion / of the capacity for experience and experiencer, through the goddess situated on the right horn.

7.s:
pibanīpūrvikābhiśca astrādyaiḥ parayāpi ca
samyagāhutayo dadyāddaśa pañca vicakṣaṇaḥ
7.d:
पिबनीपूर्विकाभिश्च अस्त्राद्यैः परयापि च
सम्यगाहुतयो दद्याद्दश पञ्च विचक्षणः
7.m: And the discerning one should properly offer fifteen oblations / with the mantras beginning with Pibatī, with Astra and the others, and with Parā.

7.s:
tato'syāparayā kāryaṃ pāśavicchedanaṃ budhaiḥ
bhuvaneśamathāmantrya tattveśvaramathāpi vā
7.d:
ततोऽस्यापरया कार्यं पाशविच्छेदनं बुधैः
भुवनेशमथामन्त्र्य तत्त्वेश्वरमथापि वा
7.m: Then the cutting of the bonds of this [disciple] should be performed by the wise with Aparā. / Then, having addressed the lord of the world, or the lord of the tattva,

7.s:
bhogabhāgā...........paścāttamidamādiśet
bhuvaneśa tvayā nāsya sādhakasya śivājñayā
7.d:
भोगभागा॥॥॥॥॥।पश्चात्तमिदमादिशेत्
भुवनेश त्वया नास्य साधकस्य शिवाज्ञया
7.m: [having offered] the share of enjoyment […], he should afterwards instruct him thus: / “O lord of the world, by the command of Śiva no obstacle is to be made by you

7.s:
pratibandhaḥ prakarttavyo yātuḥ padamanāmayam
utkṣepaṇaṃ tataḥ kuryāttayaivādhyuṣṭavarṇayā
7.d:
प्रतिबन्धः प्रकर्त्तव्यो यातुः पदमनामयम्
उत्क्षेपणं ततः कुर्यात्तयैवाध्युष्टवर्णया
7.m: for this sādhaka who is going to the painless state.” / Then he should perform the elevation with that very [mantra] of three and a half phonemes;

7.s:
anvāptimantrasaṃyogātpṛthaṅ mārgaviśuddhaye
dadyādekaikaśo dhyātvā āhutīnāṃ trayaṃ trayam
7.d:
अन्वाप्तिमन्त्रसंयोगात्पृथङ् मार्गविशुद्धये
दद्यादेकैकशो ध्यात्वा आहुतीनां त्रयं त्रयम्
7.m: in connection with the unpervaded mantra, for the purification of each path individually, / having meditated, he should offer three oblations for each one.

7.s:
tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyātparayā vauṣadantayā
śiśumutkṣipya cātmasthaṃ taddehasthaṃ ca kārayet
7.d:
ततः पूर्णाहुतिं दद्यात्परया वौषदन्तया
शिशुमुत्क्षिप्य चात्मस्थं तद्देहस्थं च कारयेत्
7.m: Then he should offer the full oblation with Parā ending in vauṣaṭ; / having elevated the child and placed him in himself, he should place him in his body.

7.s:
āhutīnāṃ trayaṃ dadyāddattvā pūrṇāhutiṃ budhaḥ
mahāpāśupatāstreṇa vilomādiviśuddhaye
7.d:
आहुतीनां त्रयं दद्याद्दत्त्वा पूर्णाहुतिं बुधः
महापाशुपतास्त्रेण विलोमादिविशुद्धये
7.m: The wise one, having given the full oblation, should offer three oblations / with the Mahāpāśupata-astra for the purification of the reverse order and the rest.

7.s:
visarjayitvā vāgīśīṃ tattvaṃ tu tadanantaram
vilīnaṃ bhāvayecchuddhamaśuddhe parameśvari
7.d:
विसर्जयित्वा वागीशीं तत्त्वं तु तदनन्तरम्
विलीनं भावयेच्छुद्धमशुद्धे परमेश्वरि
7.m: Having dismissed Vāgīśī, he should contemplate the tattva within it / dissolved, the pure [tattva] within the impure, O Supreme Lady.

7.s:
kālāntavyāptisaṃśuddhau kṛtāyāmevamādarāt
bāhupāśaṃ tu taṃ chittvā homayedājyasaṃyutam
7.d:
कालान्तव्याप्तिसंशुद्धौ कृतायामेवमादरात्
बाहुपाशं तु तं छित्त्वा होमयेदाज्यसंयुतम्
7.m: When the purification of the pervasion up to Kāla has thus been performed with diligence, / cutting that arm-bond, he should offer it into the fire together with clarified butter.

7.s:
māyātattve viśuddhe tu kaṇṭhapāśe tathā budhaḥ
māyāntamārgasaṃśuddhau dīkṣākarmaṇi sarvataḥ
7.d:
मायातत्त्वे विशुद्धे तु कण्ठपाशे तथा बुधः
मायान्तमार्गसंशुद्धौ दीक्षाकर्मणि सर्वतः
7.m: And when the Māyātattva is purified, the wise one [acts] likewise regarding the throat-bond; / in the purification of the path ending in Māyā, everywhere in the rite of initiation,

7.s:
kriyāsvanuktamantrāsu yojayedaparāṃ budhaḥ
vidyādisakalānte ca tadvadeva parāparām
7.d:
क्रियास्वनुक्तमन्त्रासु योजयेदपरां बुधः
विद्यादिसकलान्ते च तद्वदेव परापराम्
7.m: in actions where mantras are not specified, the wise one should employ Aparā; / and at the end of Sakala, beginning with Vidyā, likewise Parāparā.

7.s:
yojayennaiśvarādūrdhvaṃ pibantyādikamaṣṭakam
na cāpi sakalādūrdhvamaṅgaṣaṭkaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ
7.d:
योजयेन्नैश्वरादूर्ध्वं पिबन्त्यादिकमष्टकम्
न चापि सकलादूर्ध्वमङ्गषट्कं विचक्षणः
7.m: The discerning one should not employ the octad beginning with Pibantī above the stage of Īśvara, / nor the six limbs above Sakala.

7.s:
niṣphale parayā kāryaṃ yatkiṃcidvidhicoditam
viśuddhe sakalānte tu śikhāṃ chittvā vicakṣaṇaḥ
7.d:
निष्फले परया कार्यं यत्किंचिद्विधिचोदितम्
विशुद्धे सकलान्ते तु शिखां छित्त्वा विचक्षणः
7.m: In the transcendent (niṣkala), whatever is enjoined by the rule should be performed with Parā; / when the end of Sakala is purified, the discerning one, having cut the tuft

7.s:
hutvā cājyaṃ tataḥ śiṣyaṃ snāpayedanupūrvataḥ
ācamyābhyarcya deveśaṃ sruvamāpūrya sarpiṣā
7.d:
हुत्वा चाज्यं ततः शिष्यं स्नापयेदनुपूर्वतः
आचम्याभ्यर्च्य देवेशं स्रुवमापूर्य सर्पिषा
7.m: and offered it with clarified butter, should then bathe the disciple in proper order. / Having sipped water, worshipped the Lord of gods, and filled the ladle with ghee,

7.s:
kṛtvā śiṣyaṃ tathātmasthaṃ mūlamantramanusmaret
śivaśaktiṃ tathātmānaṃ śiṣyaṃ sarpistathānalam
7.d:
कृत्वा शिष्यं तथात्मस्थं मूलमन्त्रमनुस्मरेत्
शिवशक्तिं तथात्मानं शिष्यं सर्पिस्तथानलम्
7.m: having placed the disciple in himself in that way, he should contemplate the root mantra; / Śiva, Śakti, as well as himself, the disciple, the ghee, and the fire,

7.s:
ekīkurvañchanairgaccheddvādaśāntamananyadhīḥ
tatra kumbhakamāsthāya dhyāyansakalaniṣkalam
7.d:
एकीकुर्वञ्छनैर्गच्छेद्द्वादशान्तमनन्यधीः
तत्र कुम्भकमास्थाय ध्यायन्सकलनिष्कलम्
7.m: unifying them, he should gently proceed to the dvādaśānta with single-minded focus; / adopting breath retention there, meditating on the Sakala-Niṣkala,

7.s:
tiṣṭhettāvadanudvigno yāvadājyakṣayo bhavet
evaṃ yuktaḥ pare tattve guruṇā śivamūrtinā
7.d:
तिष्ठेत्तावदनुद्विग्नो यावदाज्यक्षयो भवेत्
एवं युक्तः परे तत्त्वे गुरुणा शिवमूर्तिना
7.m: he should remain without agitation as long as the ghee is consumed. / When he is thus joined to the supreme tattva by the guru who embodies Śiva,

7.s:
na bhūyaḥ paśutāmeti dagdhamāyānibandhanaḥ
vidhireṣa samākhyāto dīkṣākarmaṇi bhauvane
7.d:
न भूयः पशुतामेति दग्धमायानिबन्धनः
विधिरेष समाख्यातो दीक्षाकर्मणि भौवने
7.m: he never again attains the state of a bound beast, his fetters of Māyā burnt away. / This rule has been declared regarding the rite of initiation into the cosmic path of worlds;

7.s:
itarādhvavidhiṃ muktvā śivayogavidhiṃ tathā
vilomakarma saṃtyajya dviguṇastattvavartmani
7.d:
इतराध्वविधिं मुक्त्वा शिवयोगविधिं तथा
विलोमकर्म संत्यज्य द्विगुणस्तत्त्ववर्त्मनि
7.m: omitting the procedure of the other cosmic paths and the procedure of Śiva-yoga, / having abandoned the reverse operation, it is doubled on the pathway of the tattvas.

7.s:
tadvacca varṇamārge'pi caturdhā padavartmani
aṣṭadhā mantramārge'pi kalākhye'pi ca tadvidhā
7.d:
तद्वच्च वर्णमार्गेऽपि चतुर्धा पदवर्त्मनि
अष्टधा मन्त्रमार्गेऽपि कलाख्येऽपि च तद्विधा
7.m: Likewise on the cosmic path of phonemes; fourfold on the cosmic path of words; / eightfold on the cosmic path of mantras; and twofold on that named kalā.

7.s:
trikhaṇḍe viṃśatiguṇaḥ sa eva parikīrtitaḥ
iti sarvādhvasaṃśuddhiḥ samāsātparikīrtitā
7.d:
त्रिखण्डे विंशतिगुणः स एव परिकीर्तितः
इति सर्वाध्वसंशुद्धिः समासात्परिकीर्तिता
7.m: On the threefold [path], it is declared to be twentyfold. / Thus the complete purification of all cosmic paths has been stated in brief.

8.s:
sādhakācāryayoḥ karma kathyamānamataḥ śrṛṇu
atha
daśamo'dhikāraḥ
atha lakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ siddhisādhanatatparam
śāstrajñaṃ saṃyataṃ dhīramalabdhamaśaṭhaṃ dṛḍham
8.d:
साधकाचार्ययोः कर्म कथ्यमानमतः श्रृणु
अथ
दशमोऽधिकारः
अथ लक्षणसंपन्नं सिद्धिसाधनतत्परम्
शास्त्रज्ञं संयतं धीरमलब्धमशठं दृढम्
8.m:
Now hear the procedure for the sādhaka and the master being told.

Now, [the candidate should be] endowed with auspicious characteristics, devoted to the practice of attainment, / knowledgeable in scripture, self-restrained, resolute, free from greed, straightforward, firm.

8.s:
aparīkṣya gurustadvatsādhakatve niyojayet
samabhyarcya vidhānena pūrvavatparameśvaram
8.d:
अपरीक्ष्य गुरुस्तद्वत्साधकत्वे नियोजयेत्
समभ्यर्च्य विधानेन पूर्ववत्परमेश्वरम्
8.m: Having examined [him] in this manner, the guru should appoint [him] to the state of sādhaka. / Having properly worshiped the Supreme Lord as before,

8.s:
dvitīye pūrvavatkumbhaṃ hemādipayamavraṇam
sarvatra madhyapadmasya dakṣiṇaṃ dalamāśritam
8.d:
द्वितीये पूर्ववत्कुम्भं हेमादिपयमव्रणम्
सर्वत्र मध्यपद्मस्य दक्षिणं दलमाश्रितम्
8.m: in the second [vessel], as before, [he should place] a flawless water-pot made of gold or other [materials], / located on the southern petal of the central lotus everywhere.

8.s:
nāyakānāṃ pṛthagmantrānpūjayetkusumādibhiḥ
taṃ saṃtarpya sahasreṇa prakuryādabhiṣecanam
8.d:
नायकानां पृथग्मन्त्रान्पूजयेत्कुसुमादिभिः
तं संतर्प्य सहस्रेण प्रकुर्यादभिषेचनम्
8.m: He should worship the individual mantras of the chiefs with flowers and the like. / Having propitiated him with a thousand [oblations], he should perform the consecration.

8.s:
bhadrapīṭhe śubhe sthāpya śrīparṇe dārunirmite
pūrvāmukhamudagvaktraṃ snātaṃ puṣpādyalaṅkṛtam
8.d:
भद्रपीठे शुभे स्थाप्य श्रीपर्णे दारुनिर्मिते
पूर्वामुखमुदग्वक्त्रं स्नातं पुष्पाद्यलङ्कृतम्
8.m: Having placed [the candidate] upon an auspicious ceremonial seat made of śrīparṇī wood, / facing east or north, bathed, adorned with flowers and other ornaments,

8.s:
kṛtamantratanuḥ samyak samyakka kṛtamaṅgalaḥ
śaṅkhabheryādinirghoṣairvedamaṅgalanisvanaiḥ
8.d:
कृतमन्त्रतनुः सम्यक् सम्यक्क कृतमङ्गलः
शङ्खभेर्यादिनिर्घोषैर्वेदमङ्गलनिस्वनैः
8.m: having his mantra-body properly formed and every auspicious rite duly performed, / with the loud sounds of conches, kettle-drums and the like, and the auspicious chanting of the Vedas,

8.s:
sarvarājopacāreṇa kṛtvā tasyābhiṣecanam
sadāśivasamaṃ dhyātvā tatastamapi bhūṣayet
8.d:
सर्वराजोपचारेण कृत्वा तस्याभिषेचनम्
सदाशिवसमं ध्यात्वा ततस्तमपि भूषयेत्
8.m: having performed his consecration with all royal honors, / and meditating on him as equal to Sadāśiva, he should then adorn him.

8.s:
punaḥ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ mantramasmai dadedbudhaḥ
puṣpākṣatatilopetaḥ sajala....śvaraṃ nyaset
8.d:
पुनः संपूज्य देवेशं मन्त्रमस्मै ददेद्बुधः
पुष्पाक्षततिलोपेतः सजल॥॥श्वरं न्यसेत्
8.m: Having worshiped the Lord of Gods again, the wise [guru] should give the mantra to him. / Provided with flowers, unbroken grain, and sesame seeds, […] with water, he should impose the Lord.

8.s:
so'pi mūrdhani taṃ tadvanmūrtimāśritya dakṣiṇām
abhiṣicya tato'streṇa rudraśaktiṃ prakāśayet
8.d:
सोऽपि मूर्धनि तं तद्वन्मूर्तिमाश्रित्य दक्षिणाम्
अभिषिच्य ततोऽस्त्रेण रुद्रशक्तिं प्रकाशयेत्
8.m: He too, [placing] it likewise upon the head, resorting to the form on the right, / having consecrated [him], should then manifest the power of Rudra by means of the Astra [mantra].

8.s:
sa tayāliṅgya tanmantraṃ sahasreṇa pratarpayet
tadā prabhṛti tanniṣṭhastatsamānaguṇo bhavet
8.d:
स तयालिङ्ग्य तन्मन्त्रं सहस्रेण प्रतर्पयेत्
तदा प्रभृति तन्निष्ठस्तत्समानगुणो भवेत्
8.m: Embraced by her, he should satisfy that mantra with a thousand [recitations]. / From that time on, devoted to it, he becomes equal in qualities to it.

8.s:
ācāryasyābhiṣeko'yaṃ sa.......mantravidhiṃ vinā
kiṃtu tasya.......adhivāsapadānvitam
8.d:
आचार्यस्याभिषेकोऽयं स॥॥॥।मन्त्रविधिं विना
किंतु तस्य॥॥॥।अधिवासपदान्वितम्
8.m: This consecration of the master is […] without the rule of mantras; / however, his […] endowed with the preparatory rite (adhivāsa).

8.s:
evametatpadaṃ prāpyaṃ duṣprāpyamakṛtātmanām
sādhako mantrasiddhayarthaṃ mantravratamupācaret
8.d:
एवमेतत्पदं प्राप्यं दुष्प्राप्यमकृतात्मनाम्
साधको मन्त्रसिद्धयर्थं मन्त्रव्रतमुपाचरेत्
8.m: Having attained this state, hard to attain by unrefined souls, / the sādhaka should undertake the mantra-observance for the sake of mantra attainment.

8.s:
evaṃ kṛtvābhiṣekoktaṃ snātvā vidyādhipaṃ japet
lakṣamekaṃ da[śāṃśena ta]sya tarpaṇamācaret
8.d:
एवं कृत्वाभिषेकोक्तं स्नात्वा विद्याधिपं जपेत्
लक्षमेकं द[शांशेन त]स्य तर्पणमाचरेत्
8.m: Having performed as stated for consecration and having bathed, he should recite the Lord of Knowledge / one hundred thousand times, and should perform its libation with a tenth part [thereof].

8.s:
pūrvavaccābhiṣekaṃ ca kṛtvā brahmaśiro japet
tallakṣyastanmayo bhūtvā lakṣadvayamatandritaḥ
8.d:
पूर्ववच्चाभिषेकं च कृत्वा ब्रह्मशिरो जपेत्
तल्लक्ष्यस्तन्मयो भूत्वा लक्षद्वयमतन्द्रितः
8.m: And having performed the consecration as before, he should recite Brahmaśiras; / having that as his target, becoming identified with it, unwearied, [he should recite] two hundred thousand times.

8.s:
lakṣadvayaṃ ca rudrāṇīṃ catuṣkaṃ tu puruṣṭutam
lakṣāṇāṃ pañcakaṃ devi mahāpāśupataṃ japet
8.d:
लक्षद्वयं च रुद्राणीं चतुष्कं तु पुरुष्टुतम्
लक्षाणां पञ्चकं देवि महापाशुपतं जपेत्
8.m: And two hundred thousand [for] Rudrāṇī, but four [hundred thousand] for Puruṣṭuta; / O goddess, he should recite the Mahāpāśupata five hundred thousand times,

8.s:
sitaraktapītakṛṣṇavicitrāmbarabhūṣaṇaḥ
tataḥ saṃrakṣito mantrairebhirapratimo bhavet
8.d:
सितरक्तपीतकृष्णविचित्राम्बरभूषणः
ततः संरक्षितो मन्त्रैरेभिरप्रतिमो भवेत्
8.m: clothed and adorned in white, red, yellow, black, and variegated garments. / Then, protected by these mantras, he becomes matchless,

8.s:
avācyaḥ sarvaduṣṭānāṃ mantratejopabṛṃhitaḥ
evaṃ cīrṇavrato bhūtvā yaṃ sādhayitumicchati
8.d:
अवाच्यः सर्वदुष्टानां मन्त्रतेजोपबृंहितः
एवं चीर्णव्रतो भूत्वा यं साधयितुमिच्छति
8.m: unassailable by all wicked beings, augmented by the splendor of mantras. / Having thus completed the observance, whatever he desires to achieve,

8.s:
dattvārdhaṃ tasya lakṣāṇāṃ japennavakamādarāt
uttamadravyahomācca taddaśāṃśena tarpaṇam
8.d:
दत्त्वार्धं तस्य लक्षाणां जपेन्नवकमादरात्
उत्तमद्रव्यहोमाच्च तद्दशांशेन तर्पणम्
8.m: having offered an argha to it, he should recite nine hundred thousand times with devotion, / and from offering oblations of superior substances, libation with a tenth of that.

8.s:
mahākṣamāpapalānyāhuruttamādīni tadvidaḥ
madhyame dviguṇaṃ kṛtvā triguṇaṃ kanyase'pi ca
8.d:
महाक्षमापपलान्याहुरुत्तमादीनि तद्विदः
मध्यमे द्विगुणं कृत्वा त्रिगुणं कन्यसेऽपि च
8.m: Those who know these state that the superior and subsequent [substances] are mahāmāṃsa, kṣmā, and pala. / In the intermediate [level], he should make it twice as much, and thrice as much in the lowest.

8.s:
ājyaguggulunṛsnehā mahāmāṃsasamāḥ matāḥ
dadhibilvapayaḥpadmāḥ kṣmāsamāḥ parikīrtitāḥ
8.d:
आज्यगुग्गुलुनृस्नेहा महामांससमाः मताः
दधिबिल्वपयःपद्माः क्ष्मासमाः परिकीर्तिताः
8.m: Ghee, guggulu, and human fat are considered equal to mahāmāṃsa. / Curd, bilva, milk, and lotus are declared equal to kṣmā.

8.s:
dhātrīdūrvāmṛtāmīnāḥ samyagājyasamā matāḥ
tilādyairatha kurvīta navaṣaḍdviguṇaṃ kramāt
8.d:
धात्रीदूर्वामृतामीनाः सम्यगाज्यसमा मताः
तिलाद्यैरथ कुर्वीत नवषड्द्विगुणं क्रमात्
8.m: Myrobalan, dūrvā grass, guḍūcī, and fish are considered fully equal to ghee. / With sesame and the like, he should then perform ninefold, sixfold, and threefold respectively.

8.s:
pūrvamevamimaṃ kṛtvā siddherarghaṃ dadedbudhaḥ
dattvārdhaṃ tu japettāvadyāvatsiddhirabhīpsitā
8.d:
पूर्वमेवमिमं कृत्वा सिद्धेरर्घं ददेद्बुधः
दत्त्वार्धं तु जपेत्तावद्यावत्सिद्धिरभीप्सिता
8.m: Having first done this in this manner, the wise man should offer the argha of attainment; / and having offered the argha, he should recite until the desired attainment [is gained].

8.s:
lakṣeṇaikena pṛthvīśaḥ sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ
vaśamānīyate devi dvābhyāṃ rājyamavāpnuyāt
8.d:
लक्षेणैकेन पृथ्वीशः सभृत्यबलवाहनः
वशमानीयते देवि द्वाभ्यां राज्यमवाप्नुयात्
8.m: With one hundred thousand, an earthly lord with his servants, army, and mounts / is brought under control, O goddess; with two [hundred thousand], he obtains a kingdom.

8.s:
tribhirnidhānasaṃsiddhiścaturbhirbalasiddhayaḥ
pañcabhirmedinī sarvā ṣaḍbhirapsarasāṃ gaṇaḥ
8.d:
त्रिभिर्निधानसंसिद्धिश्चतुर्भिर्बलसिद्धयः
पञ्चभिर्मेदिनी सर्वा षड्भिरप्सरसां गणः
8.m: With three, the attainment of treasures; with four, the attainments of armies; / with five, the whole earth; with six, the troop of apsarases;

8.s:
saptabhiḥ sapta lokāśca daśabhistatsamo bhavet
pañcāśadbhistato gacchedavyaktāntaṃ maheśvari
8.d:
सप्तभिः सप्त लोकाश्च दशभिस्तत्समो भवेत्
पञ्चाशद्भिस्ततो गच्छेदव्यक्तान्तं महेश्वरि
8.m: with seven, the seven worlds; and with ten, he becomes equal to him. / With fifty, he goes up to the unmanifest, O Great Goddess;

8.s:
māyāntaṃ ṣaṣṭibhirlakṣairīśvarāntamaśītibhiḥ
sakalāvaniparyantaṃ koṭijaptasya siddhyati
8.d:
मायान्तं षष्टिभिर्लक्षैरीश्वरान्तमशीतिभिः
सकलावनिपर्यन्तं कोटिजप्तस्य सिद्ध्यति
8.m: with sixty hundred thousand, up to māyā; with eighty, up to Īśvara; / for one who has recited one crore, [attainment] up to all the earth succeeds.

8.s:
athavā vīracittaḥ syātkṛtvā sevāṃ yathoditām
kṛṣṇabhūtadine rātrau vidhimenaṃ samācaret
8.d:
अथवा वीरचित्तः स्यात्कृत्वा सेवां यथोदिताम्
कृष्णभूतदिने रात्रौ विधिमेनं समाचरेत्
8.m: Or, he may have the mindset of a hero: having performed the service as described, / he should perform this procedure at night on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight.

8.s:
kṛtvā pūrvoditaṃ yāgaṃ hutvā dravyamathottaram
ūrdhvakāyo japenmantrī suniṣkampottarāmukhaḥ
8.d:
कृत्वा पूर्वोदितं यागं हुत्वा द्रव्यमथोत्तरम्
ऊर्ध्वकायो जपेन्मन्त्री सुनिष्कम्पोत्तरामुखः
8.m: Having performed the sacrifice described before, and then offering oblations of the superior substance, / the practitioner of mantras, with body erect, unmoving, facing north, should recite,

8.s:
tāvadyāvatsamāyātā yogeśvaryaḥ samantataḥ
kṛtvā kalakalārāvamatighoraṃ sudāruṇam
8.d:
तावद्यावत्समायाता योगेश्वर्यः समन्ततः
कृत्वा कलकलारावमतिघोरं सुदारुणम्
8.m: until the mistress-yoginīs have assembled from all sides, / making a tumultuous, exceedingly terrifying, and dreadful roar,

8.s:
bhūmau nipatya tiṣṭhanti veṣṭyāntaḥ sādhakeśvaram
tāsāṃ kṛtvā namaskāraṃ bhittvā vāmāṅgamātmanaḥ
8.d:
भूमौ निपत्य तिष्ठन्ति वेष्ट्यान्तः साधकेश्वरम्
तासां कृत्वा नमस्कारं भित्त्वा वामाङ्गमात्मनः
8.m: and, falling to the ground, stand encircling the lord of sādhakas inside. / Having bowed down to them, piercing his own left limb,

8.s:
tadutthena tatastāsāṃ dattvārghaṃ tatsamo bhavet
ācāryo'pi ca ṣaṇmāsaṃ maunī pratidinaṃ caret
8.d:
तदुत्थेन ततस्तासां दत्त्वार्घं तत्समो भवेत्
आचार्योऽपि च षण्मासं मौनी प्रतिदिनं चरेत्
8.m: and then giving them an argha with what arises from it, he becomes their equal. / The master as well should observe silence daily for six months,

8.s:
daśa pañca ca ye mantrāḥ pūrvamuktā mayā tava
pūrvanyāsena saṃnaddhastrikālaṃ vahnikāryakṛt
8.d:
दश पञ्च च ये मन्त्राः पूर्वमुक्ता मया तव
पूर्वन्यासेन संनद्धस्त्रिकालं वह्निकार्यकृत्
8.m: armed with the earlier imposition of the fifteen mantras / which were spoken to you by me before, performing fire-rites at the three junctions of the day.

8.s:
dhyāyetpūrvoditaṃ śūlaṃ brahmacaryaṃ samāśritaḥ
kṛtvā pūrvoditaṃ yāgaṃ triśaktiparimaṇḍalam
8.d:
ध्यायेत्पूर्वोदितं शूलं ब्रह्मचर्यं समाश्रितः
कृत्वा पूर्वोदितं यागं त्रिशक्तिपरिमण्डलम्
8.m: Practicing celibacy, he should meditate on the trident described before. / Having performed the sacrifice described before, the circle of the three powers,

8.s:
abhiṣiñcettadātmānamādāvante ca deśikaḥ
evaṃ cīrṇavrato bhūtvā mantrī mantraviduttamaḥ
8.d:
अभिषिञ्चेत्तदात्मानमादावन्ते च देशिकः
एवं चीर्णव्रतो भूत्वा मन्त्री मन्त्रविदुत्तमः
8.m: the master should consecrate himself at the beginning and at the end. / Having thus completed the observance, the practitioner of mantras, supreme among knowers of mantras,

8.s:
nigrahānugrahaṃ karma kurvanna pratihanyate
śuddhayorvinyasenmūlamadhyāditritaye trayam
8.d:
निग्रहानुग्रहं कर्म कुर्वन्न प्रतिहन्यते
शुद्धयोर्विन्यसेन्मूलमध्यादित्रितये त्रयम्
8.m: is not obstructed when performing the act of subjugation or grace. / On both purified [hands], he should impose the root mantra: three on the triad of middle and other [fingers],

8.s:
vāmāṅguṣṭhe tale netre tarjannyāmastrameva ca
akṣahīmiti khaṇḍena śabdarāśiṃ niveśayet
8.d:
वामाङ्गुष्ठे तले नेत्रे तर्जन्न्यामस्त्रमेव च
अक्षहीमिति खण्डेन शब्दराशिं निवेशयेत्
8.m: the Tulā [mantra] on the left thumb, the Netra on the [left] index finger, and Astra [mantra] likewise. / With the segment ‘akṣahrīm’, he should place the aggregate of sounds;

8.s:
naphahīmityanenāpi śaktimūrtiṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ
viparītamahāmudrāmayogānmūlameva ca
svasthāneṣu tathāṅgāni nyāsaḥ sāmānya ityayam
iti śrīmālinīvijayottare tantre'bhiṣekādhikāro daśamaḥ
8.d:
नफहीमित्यनेनापि शक्तिमूर्तिं विचक्षणः
विपरीतमहामुद्रामयोगान्मूलमेव च
स्वस्थानेषु तथाङ्गानि न्यासः सामान्य इत्ययम्
इति श्रीमालिनीविजयोत्तरे तन्त्रेऽभिषेकाधिकारो दशमः
8.m:
with ‘naphahrīm’, the wise man [places] the embodiment of power; / from the application of the inverted Mahāmudrā, [he places] the root mantra,

and likewise the ancillary limbs in their proper places. This is the general imposition.

Thus ends the tenth chapter, the Qualification for Consecration, in the venerable Mālinīvijayottaratantra.

9.s:
atha
ekādaśo'dhikāraḥ
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dīkṣāṃ paramadurlabhām
bhuktimuktikarīṃ samyaksadyaḥpratyayakārikām
9.d:
अथ
एकादशोऽधिकारः
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि दीक्षां परमदुर्लभाम्
भुक्तिमुक्तिकरीं सम्यक्सद्यःप्रत्ययकारिकाम्
9.m: Now, therefore, I shall clearly declare the initiation that is exceedingly difficult to obtain, / which grants enjoyment and liberation, and produces immediate conviction.

9.s:
nāsyāṃ maṇḍalakuṇḍādi kiṃcidapyupayujyate
na ca nyāsādikaṃ pūrvaṃ snānādi ca yathecchayā
9.d:
नास्यां मण्डलकुण्डादि किंचिदप्युपयुज्यते
न च न्यासादिकं पूर्वं स्नानादि च यथेच्छया
9.m: In this, neither maṇḍala, hearth-pit, nor anything else is used; / nor is there prior imposition and the like, and bathing etc. is at will.

9.s:
praviśya yāgasadanaṃ sūpaliptaṃ sucarcitam
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi dhṛpuṣpāmbarabhūṣitaḥ
9.d:
प्रविश्य यागसदनं सूपलिप्तं सुचर्चितम्
प्राङ्मुखोदङ्मुखो वापि धृपुष्पाम्बरभूषितः
9.m: Having entered the sacrificial pavilion, well-smeared and well-anointed, / facing east or north, adorned with good flowers and garments,

9.s:
dīptāṃ śaktimanusmṛtya pādāgrānmastakāvadhi
mahāmudrāprayogena nirdagdhāṃ cintayettanum
9.d:
दीप्तां शक्तिमनुस्मृत्य पादाग्रान्मस्तकावधि
महामुद्राप्रयोगेन निर्दग्धां चिन्तयेत्तनुम्
9.m: bearing in mind the blazing Power from the tips of the toes to the head, / through the application of the Mahāmudrā he should imagine his body completely burnt.

9.s:
anulomaprayogācca mālinīmamṛtaprabhām
cintayettanuniṣpatyai taddhyānagatamānasaḥ
9.d:
अनुलोमप्रयोगाच्च मालिनीममृतप्रभाम्
चिन्तयेत्तनुनिष्पत्यै तद्ध्यानगतमानसः
